articleTitle: Childhood Asthma Disease Prediction Using Classification Algorithms of Supervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Asthma is a very dangerous lung disease in which our airways are swollen and become narrow and blocked. Air does not flow through narrow airways properly. It is an ongoing disease and does not go away, regular treatment is needed lifelong. According to the survey report, 25 million people in the United States are living with this disease and out of that 5 million are children who are asthma patients. Asthma is a life-threatening disease if don’t get treatment timely, can lose your life. Early prediction of this disease among children not only provides a recovery solution for the disease but also helps to increase their lifetime. The proposed designed Intelligent system provides useful resources to the healthcare system to make accurate decisions for preventing asthma in childhood. The research paper aims to design an intelligent artificial-based machine learning classification model to predict asthma disease among children aged less than 10 years. Research also included a comparative analysis of different classification methods of machine learning like Linear regression, KNN Model, Decision Trees, Random Forests and Support Vector machines. It also helps to select the best model by analyzing the performances of these algorithms based on efficiency and accuracy. The outcomes of the research paper to study asthma prediction using different classification models and help doctors and patients to take the right decision timely.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Liver Disease Prediction Using Supervised Machine Learning Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Liver is most fundamental part of human body. It is highly dependable to performing several body functions such as helping in food digestion, waste filtering, enzyme activation, detoxification, nutrition and glycogen storage, carbohydrate metabolism, vitamin and mineral storage etc. It has been found from various survey reports that across the world, 58 million people are suffering from liver disorders and nearly 01 million liver disorder patients are present in India. The growth rate of liver disorder patients is increasing rapidly worldwide due to a sharp rise in obesity, eating more junk foods, more alcohol consumption and unhealthy lifestyles. People who have liver disorders problem need medical treatment at the correct time and early disease prediction helps to reduce the number of deaths. The research focuses on designing an intelligent system that helps for prediction liver disorder by using various classification models of supervised machine learning and it also helps to prevent becoming India a global hub of liver diseases by 2030. The research emphasis on comparative performance analysis of different classification algorithms and ensemble methods. It also helps to select best accurate model for prediction of the liver diseases.

articleTitle: Open Market: A Proposal To Improve Engagement and Motivation Among Students Towards Basic Programming Subjects
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Gamification can be applied to grab the attention of people in wide range of environments. This work sheds light upon the prospects of its application in classroom to deliver the education related to computer programming is called “Open Market”. To study the impact upon students after applying this strategy, the level of motivation, engagement and learning were explored. This paper proposed a novel engagement model to improve learning level in student and comp are the impact of gamification method from traditional methods in terms of assessment methods for “Open Market”. This paper also encourages student’s agenda in student learning process by analyzing standard deviation in learning in number of parameters like age, subject, motivation type, and intrinsic method for engagement in programming subjects like C, C++, Python, Java etc. The outcome of the study contends in the support of open market strategy to be indulged in the teaching and learning mechanism.

articleTitle: Advancements of Machine Learning Algorithms for Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In order to secure global food security, the whole world is dependent on the agriculture sector. However, existance of various plant diseases leads to major threat to quality and quantity of the crops, which further compromises the food production. Therefore, early and accurate disease detection is necessary for taking timely decisions to prevent the crops. Currently, most of the farmers uses observation-based techniques to detect the plant disease. However, these approaches are time consuming and are dependent on the experience of the person performing them. Recently, studies have implemented machine learning algorithms to automate the detection of plant diseases. This paper reviews the state of art of machine learning approaches implemented for plant disease detection. The work explores various phases of the process, including the creation of datasets, extraction of features, selection of models, and metrics for evaluation. The work reports that CNN have demonstrated high accuracy in image-based detection of plant diseases, outperforming traditional machine learning algorithms. Further, the paper presents the challenges and future prospects in this domain, offering valuable insights for researchers and practitioners aiming to develop robust and efficient systems for plant disease detection

articleTitle: Deep-SignSpeak: Deep Learning based Sign Language Recognition and Regional Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Hearing impaired and silent people have a tough time communicating with others in society. It may undermine their self-esteem and make them feel separated from others. Traditional Hand Gesture Recognition Systems face limitations as they heavily rely on explicit hand-crafted features, hindering adaptability to diverse signing styles. Their ability to capture intricate spatial and temporal characteristics is diminished, and their scalability is affected. There are issues with managing changes in ambient light and noise level. Rule-Based Systems, which are based on pre-established rules, are limited in their ability to adjust to the dynamic nature of sign languages, are unable to handle the complexities of different types of signing, and have a tendency to oversimplify sign language patterns. The accuracies of these existing systems were not that much compromising, so that in order to produce an optimum model for sign language interpretation deep learning models are used. This proposed system offers a thorough approach to Sign Language Recognition(SLR).This system focuses on breaking down video input into individual image frames and building three different models: EfficientNetV2, EfficientNetV2L, and ConvNeXtLarge algorithm. The dataset used includes a variety of sign languages, offering a representative and varied sample for training the model. Feeding the dataset into the models during the training phase helps the models become proficient in identifying and deciphering sign language motions. The model's effectiveness is then thoroughly tested by dissecting each individual frame that is produced from videos and evaluating performance measures. After the top-performing model is chosen, there is a transformative stage in which a translator is used to translate the model's output which is predicted is now converted into 22 different regional languages based on the user’s need. The accuracy yielded by the three models EfficientNet_V2, EfficientNet_V2L and ConvNextLarge are 94.20%, 92.54% and 95.21% respectively. The model with the highest accuracy is preferred for recognizing the Sign Languages.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Fusion for a Multi-Biometric Identification Using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Now a days for security aspect identify a person with his/her biometric traits are very popular as well as applicable also with high accuracy. Many of the applications use unimodal biometric identification but in unimodal biometric identification system accuracy is very low. These combinations of two or more than two biometric traits give high accuracy. Here defines the comparison of single and multibiometric recognition approaches and role of deep learning based fusion in multimodel identification process. In this paper proposed a LSTM (Long Short Term Memory) model for re-recognize a person using Face and Gait Biometric trains with high accuracy. The proposed method gives 99.67% accuracy. The results point out that the biometric acknowledgment system using deep learning is secure, robust, and reliable. The use of this LSTM approach is in such area where high accuracy needed. such as police or defense organization where need high accuracy. We can also use this framework when we authenticate a person by drone.

articleTitle: A Review of Anomaly Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Anomaly detection is different in different areas or context and the definition of anomaly also changes from problem to problem. Classical techniques like classification and clustering are not effective when it comes to identify anomaly in graph structured data. This paper examines various anomaly detection methods, focusing on classification, clustering, time series data, and problems related to graph-based structures. On the basis of existing studies, we have emphasized that anomaly detection algorithms applied on graphs using Graph Neural network are much accurate.

articleTitle: A novel approach for optical RIS aided VLC communication in 5G IoT networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: With the emergence of Internet-of-things (IoT) enabled consumer applications, there is widespread augmentation of IoT devices, smart wearables and smart consumer electronics. Owing to the limited capabilities of 5G sub 6GHz technology and millimeter wave (mmWave) technology, optical wireless communication (OWC) is widely adopted in the IoT networks for high data rates and high bandwidth applications. This paper presents a visible light communication (VLC) 5G IoT network that uses VLC transmitters to serve the network IoT nodes fitted with photodiodes (PDs). An optical reconfigurable intelligent surface (ORIS) is used to overcome the line-of-sight (LoS) signal obstructions through controlled reflection. The performance of the VLC network is investigated for achievable sum rate under different ORIS elements and different optical transmit powers. It is observed that 90% of the user nodes in the network achieve higher sum rate with increased N. Further, the effect of ORIS phase shift is evaluated. In the end, the performance comparison of different VLC communication setups is also investigated.

articleTitle: Prediction of Breast Cancer utilizing Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Breast Cancer is the first cause of death for cancer in women. The application of Machine learning techniques in medical fields is one of the fastest-growing areas in disease diagnosis. A machine learning-based breast cancer prediction system is designed for early diagnosis. It shows the traditional methods, which are time-consuming. The following study develops a system for diagnosing the prediction of Breast Cancer that will help the doctors to predict the disease of the patients. This paper presents a dataset containing 569 samples in total, where records are labeled as either benign or malignant. The machine learning models for Predicting Breast Cancer implement and test datasets. Thus, we compared the precision, F1, recall, and accuracy of all three ML algorithms, and the accuracy of the Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest model is 96%, 93%, and 97%, respectively. Thus, better accuracy from the Random Forest model is 97% which is best out of all three models. In future this model can be used for tier-three cities for the early detection of breast cancer.

articleTitle: A Review on Deep Learning Techniques for skin disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Skin cancer ranks among the most concerning global health threats. Correct skin cancer diagnosis is difficult to achieve. Timely recognition of skin cancer symptoms is crucial due to the increasing incidence rates, notable mortality rates, and substantial financial burden linked with medical interventions. Assumed the severity of complications, experts have made several primary recognition methods for skin disease. Deep learning algorithms have been engineered to excel across diverse tasks and are increasingly leveraged for diagnosing skin diseases. We presents a review of deep-learning techniques for diagnosing skin disease. We initial provide a brief description of skin disease and describe some readily accessible skin datasets. Then examine well-liked deep learning architectures and well-liked frameworks aiding deep learning algorithm implementation. This article’s main goal is to offer a conceptual and comprehensive evaluation of recent efforts on deep learning-based skin disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Advancements in IoT-Enabled Smart Vehicle Security Systems (SVSS)
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Advanced Vehicle Security Systems (AVSS) significantly advance vehicular safety technologies. The recommended system incorporates three elements aimed at enhancing the overall driving experience. The adaptive headlight control utilizes light-dependent resistor (LDR) sensors to augment nighttime driving safety. The paper discusses how Adjusting the headlight intensity in response to ambient light conditions minimizes glare and enhances visibility. The Emergency Support System (ESS) support GPS, GSM, and accelerometer technologies to offer prompt aid during accidents or emergencies, facilitating the communication with emergency services while transmitting precise location details, thus ensuring driver and passenger safety.Intelligent parking aids utilize ultrasonic sensors to simplify parking and prevent collisions with objects or travelers, enhancing mobility and safety through immediate driver feedback. This research paper discusses the comprehensive functionality and practical implementation of each AVSS component. It has been observed that the AVSS not only underscores the potential of technology to elevate vehicular safety but also sets the stage for future innovations in intelligent vehicle technologies.

articleTitle: Social Influence on Shopping Using Ant Colony Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Understanding how social influence on purchasing affects customers is critical for businesses looking to increase customer engagement, sales, and the shopping experience. This project's main objective is the development of a model that would identify the market segment that will react effectively to attractive approaches to marketing, such as influence marketing, social mediapromotions, and specific advertisements. To do this, to predict customer responsiveness, we used a variety of regression models, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Ant Colony Optimization, and Normalization. The results of this research provide important details about how various customer categories respond to social influence strategies. In conclusion, Organizations must understand which market segments respond best to these techniques. It enables them to properly manage resources and target particular groups with their marketing initiatives, optimizing their return on investment. Our experiment helps organizations to improve their marketing tactics with the aid of this study. For instance, if a certaincustomer category is shown to be extremely sensitive to influence marketing, a business might commit more resources to this channelto efficiently target that segment.

articleTitle: A Portable Object Detection System for Visually Impaired Individuals in Outdoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In recent years, progress in machine learning methods has greatly influenced the creation of assistive technologies designed to enhance the quality of life for individuals with visual impairments. This paper introduces a unique real-time image analysis method specifically developed for the visually impaired community. Leveraging the You Only Look Once (YOLO) dataset and machine learning algorithms implemented in Python, our The suggested system provides a seamless and efficient solution for identifying objects in the circumventing environment in genuine-time. In this study, we performed comprehensive experiments to assess the effectiveness of our system, taking into account aspects like detection accuracy, processing speed, and usability for users with visual impairments. The results demonstrate the efficacy and reliability of our approach in genuine-world scenarios, showcasing its potential to be accommodated as a valuable and implement for improving autonomy and mobility of visually impaired individuals.

articleTitle: ASA: Adaptive Spectrum Allocation Schemes to Reduce Spectrum Fragmentation in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: To fulfils the current torrent of high speed and flexible bandwidth internet traffic demand, Elastic Optical Network (EON) played a vital role in data transmission and communication systems. The present work addresses spectrum fragmentation (SF) problem occurs in EONs due to the varied bandwidth requirement and unequal allocation of frequency slots (FSs) to accommodate the connection requests. In this paper, we propose three Adaptive Spectrum Allocation (ASA) schemes namely RSA-ASA1, RSA-ASA2, and RSA-ASA3, each adopting a different spectrum allotment criterion. Each ASA scheme has been evaluated and tested on the standard ARPANET network topology and their performance is compared with the conventional first fit spectrum allocation (SA) policy, termed as RSA-FF, on three different metrics: network spectrum fragmentation (NSF), the number of connections established, and spectrum utilization ratio (SUR). The simulation outcome of the proposed ASA scheme shows improved results as compared to RSA-FF scheme. The NSF value of the proposed RSA-ASA1, RSA-ASA2, RSA-ASA3 schemes reduces 5.13%, 3.34%, and 6%, respectively as compared to the RSA-FF scheme. Similarly, each proposed scheme increases the number of connections established. Among all the schemes RSA-ASA3 scheme outperforms on each evaluating metrics.

articleTitle: Feature Fusion-Based Deep Learning Model to Ensure Worker Safety at Construction Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Safety helmets must be worn at construction to avoid injuries. Manual inspection of safety helmets for every worker requires a lot of human effort which is a costlier and tedious task. Hence, visual inspection can save human effort and reduce the cost. It helps the manager to send safety reminders to the workers. Therefore, this paper describes a feature fusion method to detect safety helmets at construction sites without human intervention. Because of the complex sciences of a construction site, this paper proposed a vibrant deep-learning solution with a better accuracy rate. Here, safety helmets are identified with a feature fusion deep learning model. The features of images are extracted with a hand-crafted deep learning model and pre-trained models that are later fused into a matrix with the fusion technique. Finally, the classification was employed with a convolution neural network. The proposed model was compared with other state-of-the-art deep learning models, and it outperforms with 98.90% correct classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Ensemble Explainable Artificial Intelligence Model for COVID-19 Detection Using Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: After the virus was initially detected in Wuhan, China, in December 2019, it was announced in the midst of 2020 that an outbreak of COVID-19 had occurred, marking the onset of a global pandemic. Experts have put forth the hypothesis that this particular virus has the capability to infect both the upper respiratory system, including the sinuses, nose, and throat, as well as the lower respiratory system, encompassing the trachea and lungs. The most prevalent modes of transmission are through airborne droplets and direct contact with individuals carrying the COVID-19 virus. Currently, there are countless individuals across the globe who are grappling with this illness. Despite widespread preventive measures, the number of individuals affected by this disease and the death toll associated with it continue to rise at a disconcerting pace. There is a pressing need for ComputerAided Diagnosis (CAD) methods that can accurately identify this disease, yet many existing models are not utilized due to their lack of explainability. In this particular investigation, we present a methodology for swiftly and precisely identifying COVID-19 in Chest X-Ray (CXR) images, as this is the most commonly used and easily accessible medical diagnostic tool. To accomplish this, we employ DenseNet 121, a Deep Learning Model, on our dataset and achieve an impressive accuracy rate of 98.88%. Furthermore, we integrate Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) models, specifically GRAD CAM ++ and SHAP, as an ensemble approach to enhance the interpretability of our classification model. This integration allows for a clearer visualization of the decision-making process and supports medical professionals in understanding how the algorithm arrives at its decisions.

articleTitle: MRI Based Brain Tumor Segmentation with Ensemble Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In order to analyze and track the development of the disease, automated segmentation of brain tumors from multimodal MR images is crucial. When compared to traditional, context-based computer vision techniques, deep learning algorithms perform better for semantic segmentation. Segmenting brain tumors with far more precision is now possible because to Convolutional Neural Networks, making them commonly used for biomedical image segmentation. This research introduces a notable yet simple combinatorial method that enhances the accuracy of predictions by merging two segmentation networks, specifically VGG16 and ResNet50. Before merging to generate a conclusive forecast, the two models underwent separate training on the BRATS dataset and were evaluated to generate segmentation maps. The segmentation of tumors differed significantly among the various sub-regions depicted in these maps. The suggested ensemble method (ES-BT) surpassed the most advanced architectures on the validation set, with an accuracy of 98.5%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Fusion for Crop Yield Estimation: A Comparative Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The backbone of India's economy and population is agriculture. Unfortunately, unpredictable weather patterns and outdated farming practices, such as manual surveys and weather-based models, often hinder optimal yield and sustainability. These practices can limit productivity and resilience in the face of changing environmental conditions. The proposed Hybrid-DX model, a powerful combination of the deep learning algorithm DNN and the ensemble method XGBoost, aims to address these issues by integrating advanced data analytics with traditional agricultural practices. This integration enhances decision-making and optimizes yield in the face of various challenges. We compared and evaluated the performance of several algorithms, like Linear Regression, XGBoost, Random Forest, DNN, LSTM, CNN, along with the proposed Hybrid-DX. The insights from our research can assist farmers in making informed decisions by providing better predictions. With the proposed Hybrid-DX model, farmers can overcome the challenges of agriculture and ensure a brighter future for themselves and the economy.

articleTitle: Analyzing Market Sentiment for Gold Commodity News Through Natural Language Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This study explores how sentiment analysis methods can be applied to evaluate commodity news with a specific focus on the gold market investors and traders can understand the opinions expressed in news articles by utilizing the wealth of financial news data available to them this study examines sentiment patterns in gold-related news reports using machine learning and NLP techniques it is anticipated that the research’s conclusions will provide both business communities with new information making decisions could be made easier for traders and investors if they are aware of the relationship between news, sentiment and market dynamics. In this paper, count vectorizer has been implemented for feature extraction and machine learning classifier algorithm like random forest for sentiment analysis. Gold news is categorized as having positive, negative, neutral and no sentiment. Other performance metrics like F1 Score 73%, Recall 68% and Precision 93% were calculated for the comparison of sentiment classes. Hyperparameter tuning is employed to improve the model effectiveness. The findings demonstrate a high accuracy of 86% in sentiment analysis to predict public sentiments in commodity markets which could help stakeholders develop investment strategies.

articleTitle: Enhanced Automated Diagnosis of Pneumonia from X-ray Images using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Pneumonia, a type of dangerous lung infection (bacterial or viral) among which especially children and seniors are in high risk. Early detection and timely intervention is the key for the successful management of pneumonia anomalies during early lung stages. This approach considerably raises the odds of survival. A special design of convolutional neural networks that is customized for medical chest images aims to detect instances of pneumonia infection. The obtained tracking performance is notably excellent, having an accuracy of up to 94.86% as well. Additionally, the model demonstrated good recall performance of 96%, which means a considerable number of true positives were correctly identified. Thus, such combination of high sensitivity and specificity is necessary to help medical experts recognize early pneumonia cases and thus prompt early intervention that becomes the basis for better outcomes among patients. The performance this model is assessed against existing scientific models of the landscape and the results coincide, bolstering the confidence in the usefulness of the proposed structure. The results of this research have potential for optimization of diagnostics in medical workplaces and medical care advancement.

articleTitle: Enhanced Lung Nodule Classification through Ensemble Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Currently, lung cancer ranks as the second leading cause of mortality worldwide, surpassed only by heart attacks. Lung cancer is characterised by the formation of a malignant tumour in the lung, which has the potential to spread over time. The presence of this tumour can be identified in computed tomography (CT) scan images by the presence of distinct spots in the lung area. Occasionally, it might be challenging to visually identify these spots due to the inherent limitations of the human eye in perceiving subtle details. Moreover, these spots are often recognised only in the latter phases. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can effectively detect smaller abnormalities in the lung area, allowing for more detailed inspection. This paper utilises CT-scan pictures. The photos have been enhanced for classification by applying preprocessing techniques such as median filtering for noise reduction and Otsu's approach for thresholding. 3 pre-trained CNN models, including VGG16, ResNet50, and InceptionV3, have been utilised with alterations. The classification layers of these models have been eliminated and reconfigured to be trained on the particular dataset. The preprocessing processes will provide input images to the convolutional layers of these models. The output from these layers will be combined and used as the beginning layer for the newly created dense layer, which will include output nodes representing 3 classes: normal, benign, and malignant. This model achieves a remarkable accuracy of 98% on the testing dataset.

articleTitle: Gesture Based Model using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: It's a pretty innovative way to make presentations more interactive and engaging. Instead of fumbling with a clicker or computer, we can use hand gestures to navigate the slides. It's a simple and intuitive method that can make a big difference in the effectiveness of our presentation. We are describing a system that allows users to control a slideshow using hand gestures instead of pausing and operating it with a keyboard. This presentation is quite interesting and informative. It is focused on exploring the effectiveness of gesture-based interfaces in Human-Computer Interaction. The research aims to provide valuable insights into the relationship between users and technology and how it can be improved through gesture-driven interaction. This research delves into the effectiveness of gesture recognition algorithms, user learning curves, and the impact of environmental factors on system performance.

articleTitle: Towards Precision Medicine: Deep Learning Models for Cervical Cancer Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Cervical cancer poses a significant danger to the lives of women globally and with the changing lifestyle choices leading to a rise in the number of detected cases, early detection and treatment are imperative for combating this disease, particularly in developing countries. Cervical cancer often presents as squamous cell carcinoma or adenocarcinoma. The development of more accurate diagnostic and therapeutic models to address this challenge has been greatly helped by the additional input of Machine Learning. Literature suggests that the use of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in conjunction with convolutional neural networks (CNN) enhances the efficiency of cervical cancer detection and prevention. These approaches enable the identification of cancerous cells, with specialized models such as CNN. However, the computational demands of image processing and preprocessing pose significant challenges. In response to these challenges, our research proposes an efficient deep-learning model tailored for cervical cancer detection in high-resolution cervical images. This model incorporates three distinct feature selection modules—low-variance feature extraction, - dimensional feature selection, and recursive feature elimination— while integrating multiple views of cervical images. We evaluated various classification models, including ResNet, DenseNet, and VGG, for cervical cancer diagnosis. Simulation results are considered to validate the proposed model's accuracy. Using AI and ML techniques, our model aims to contribute to advancing cervical cancer diagnosis and treatment, ultimately improving the efficiency in treating cervical cancer.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Pretrained Models: A Focus on Initial Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Early detection of diabetic retinopathy is crucial because this disease currently has no cure. Identifying the condition at an early stage can significantly help in halting its progression and preventing severe vision loss. Numerous studies have focused on the detection and classification of diabetic retinopathy using various machine learning and deep learning techniques. In this work, we aim to detect the disease in its initial stages using a pre-trained VGG16 model, which is proved to be efficient in many image recognition tasks by recent researchers. Our initial approach achieved an accuracy of 79%, indicating a promising potential for early detection. To further improve the detection accuracy, we incorporated Ben Graham's preprocessing method, which enhances the finer details of the retinal images. This enhancement led to a 5% increase in accuracy, resulting in a final accuracy of 84.40%. These results underscore the effectiveness of advanced preprocessing techniques combined with deep learning models in the early detection of diabetic retinopathy.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis with RNNs: Insights from LIME Interpretability
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This research article explores different facets of sentiment analysis like data pre-processing, extracting useful features, model designs & evaluation criteria. We explore recurrent neural network (RNN), having two layers of Bidirectional LSTM, to classify user language into positive, and negative classes. Our experiment involves training these models on large-scale sentiments-based datasets and evaluating their performance by extending more features and techniques of deep learning. We compare and visualize accuracy with respect to accuracy score, confusion matrix, precision-recall curve as well as ROC curve. The results demonstrate that the BiLSTM model achieves competitive sentiment classification accuracy. The classification trust concern is addressed using LIME, an interpretable machine learning model. The major contribution of this research is towards the field of sentiment analysis by evaluating the model and emphasizing importance of explainability.

articleTitle: A Robust Framework for Crowdfunding Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Crowdfunding platforms have emerged as trans-formative tools for young entrepreneurs to raise capital for their projects. However, the proliferation of scams and lack of transparency have hindered the trust between donors and recipients. This paper explores the integration of blockchain technology into crowdfunding platforms as a solution to enhance transparency, security, and accountability. Blockchain, renowned for its unparalleled levels of security and transparency, offers a decentralized ledger system that ensures the integrity of transactions. By leveraging blockchain, crowdfunding platforms can establish immutable records of transactions, thereby building confidence among project creators and backers.This research investigates how blockchain integration addresses the current challenges faced by crowdfunding platforms. It examines the potential of blockchain to foster trust by providing a transparent record of fund utilization, ensuring that backers can verify that their contributions are allocated appropriately. Moreover, this paper delves into the revolutionary impact of blockchain on financial dynamics, promoting inclusivity in the fundraising process. By eliminating intermediaries and reducing transaction costs, blockchain facilitates direct peer-to-peer interactions, democratizing access to capital for innovators worldwide. In conclusion, the adoption of blockchain technology in crowd-funding platforms holds immense promise for transforming the fundraising landscape. Through enhanced transparency and security, blockchain fosters trust, facilitates inclusive financing, and empowers entrepreneurs to realize their visions

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Aadhaar Identification and authentication system
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to enhance the security and integrity of India’s Aadhaar system by integrating blockchain and IPFS technology. This project aims to address problems in current system. Our solution involves storing sensitive Aadhaar data off-chain on IPFS, with only content identifiers along with hashed Aadhar ID stored on the blockchain. Smart contracts on Ethereum implement Role-Based Access Control for robust access management along with an audit trail for transparency of Aadhaar data usage. This integration ensures tamper-resistance and enhances privacy while facilitating efficient verification with an audit mechanism.

articleTitle: Power and area-efficient digital filters for communication applications
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The paper introduces an innovative time-dependent finite impulse response (FIR) filter designed for utilization in time-mode signal processing systems like mobile phones and digital transmitters-receivers. The filter’s functioning structure is embedded in the principles of high-level transformation techniques like parallel processing and folding. In this paper 6-tap FIR filter is designed and implemented using parallel processing and folding techniques for low power consumption and area minimization. The proposed FIR filter is modeled in Xilinx using Verilog hardware descriptive language and synthesized with the XST tool. The target implementation platform is the Xilinx ML605 embedded development kit to investigate the LUTs and power consumption of the design. The proposed filter reduces the major concern parameters of a design as power and area. The implementation results discover that the area is reduced to 90.83% of the existing method and power is reduced to 67.25% of the existing method. The findings represent a significant step ahead in hardware efficiency optimization.

articleTitle: Arduino-Powered Sonar Radar MOKSH: Design, Implementation, and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The Arduino-controlled radar systems constituting the fundamental elements of this RADAR system, an ultrasonic sensor and servo motor are employed. The fundamental operation of the system is to detect objects within the range specified. Attached to the servo motor is an ultrasonic sensor that rotates approximately 180 degrees and provides a graphical representation on the processing IDE software. In addition to providing a graphical representation, the Processing IDE also provides the object's angle, position, and distance. The administration of this system is facilitated by Arduino. The Arduino UNO board is adequate for both interface development and ultrasonic sensor and display device control. We learned about extant navigation and obstacle detection innovations as well as various systems that make efficient use of ultrasonic sensors through our research. This RADAR system is primarily utilized in the fields of object identification, mapping, surveillance, and monitoring, in addition to navigation and positioning. Additionally, these low-cost systems are appropriate for implementation indoors.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Diagnosis through Chest X-Ray Images Leveraging VGG16 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The ongoing COVID-19 pandemic has demanded developing efficient and reliable diagnostic tools to combat the virus's dissemination. In this paper, we have put forward a novel approach based on deep learning for the automated recognition of COVID-19 from chest X-ray images, based on the VGG16 architecture. Utilizing a dataset containing X-ray images of the chest of people who are both COVID-19 positive as well as negative, we trained and evaluated the VGG16 model for its diagnostic performance. Through rigorous experimentation and validation, this proposed model has achieved an remarkable accuracy of 98.2%, demonstrating its worth in effectively differentiating between COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 patients. Furthermore, we conducted extensive comparative analyses with existing approaches, showcasing the superiority of our suggested model in terms of computing efficiency and accuracy. Achieved results highlight the prospective of methodologies based on deep learning, particularly the VGG16 model, as a valuable tool when combating the COVID-19 epidemic, offering rapid and reliable diagnosis to aid in effective patient management and community wellbeing interventions, and the precision, recall, and F1 score of the suggested model yield positive values of 0.98, 0.98, and 0.98.

articleTitle: Offensive Speech Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: As social media and the internet have grown in popularity, people now have access to a variety of forums for openly expressing their ideas and opinions on a wide range of topics. However, this freedom of expression is exploited to inspire hatred against specific persons or groups of individuals owing to disparities in gender, race, or religion, among other considerations. To address this growing problem on social networking sites, recent research have used breakthroughs in machine learning algorithms and feature engineering approaches to automate the identification of hate speech posts across a range of datasets. Advances in machine intelligence have piqued the interest of academics seeking and applying solutions to the problem of hate speech. Currently, hate speech is identified using a decision tree algorithm and text data.

articleTitle: Skin Lesion 7 Class Classification using MobileNetV2 CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The occurrence of skin diseases is widespread across all age groups. These illnesses are more prevalent than other types of health issues. Although traditional diagnostic methods, such as visual examination, biopsy, and microscopic analysis, are available, their accuracy is heavily dependent on skilled professionals or individuals. This paper presents a method for classifying skin lesions utilizing lightweight deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with a focus on the MobileNetV2 architecture. Our study employed data up-sampling and data augmentation techniques to enhance the efficiency of the classifier. By utilizing transfer learning with pre-trained models like MobileNetV2, we developed a system that analyzes the HAM10000 dataset, a collection of 10015 dermoscopic images, to achieve an accuracy of 90.30% (categorical), 96.91% (top 2) accuracy, for classifying 7 skin diseases on an Android application. This tool has the potential to assist doctors in detecting skin cancer at an early stage.

articleTitle: A Unified Communication Model for Multiple Sensory Disabilities Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Day by day the ratio of deaf, blind, and deaf-blind people is increasing rapidly and according to research conducted over 15 million of the world’s population is living with these disabilities. With the advancement in technology, these sensory disabled can communicate with each other still many such people it difficult to communicate. This paper proposes a communication model that will make communication between people with sensory disabilities much easier. In this work, we create an all-in-one user interface that contains different modes of communication on a single platform. Speech is being converted to text using speech recognition, hand gestures to text using the CNN model, and Braille script to text using Python libraries. This would help many people to communicate without any hassle and allow deferentially able to live life like abled people. Our research focuses on making communication easier among any person who has a disability or multiple disabilities so that they can communicate easily and properly. We focus on making the solution easier and simpler as much as possible.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-Based Analysis of Stock Market Forecasting: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The financial market is inherently complicated and dynamic, which has increased interest in adapting machine learning (ML) approaches to stock market forecasting. The body of research on machine learning-based stock market forecasting methods is thoroughly examined in this study. The objective is to evaluate the present status of research in the field, spot trends, and emphasize the biggest opportunities and obstacles.

articleTitle: Vehicle Colour, Speed and Type Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This research presents a novel method that combines machine learning and computer vision for simultaneous vehicle speed estimation, color detection, and mood estimation. Our system aims to improve road safety and optimize traffic control by leveraging radar and lidar technologies for accurate speed estimation, while advanced deep learning algorithms handle color detection and mood prediction of drivers. Through extensive testing, we achieved high accuracy in speed estimation, with an average error margin of less than 5%, and vehicle color detection accuracy exceeding 95%. Additionally, our mood prediction model demonstrated a significant correlation with driver behavior, showcasing its potential to predict risk factors on the road. The results confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of our approach, revealing its potential to transform traffic management practices. Furthermore, we propose future research directions to integrate vehicle type prediction into our framework, paving the way for smarter, more adaptive, and safer transportation solutions.

articleTitle: Fingerprint and Face Detection with Self Banking Biometric and GSM Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The advancement of biometric technology has opened new frontiers in enhancing security measures, particularly in critical systems like Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). This paper presents “Biometric Fortress,” a novel approach utilizing Raspberry Pi-based face and fingerprint recognition systems to bolster the security of ATM operations. By integrating biometric authentication methods, this system aims to mitigate the vulnerabilities associated with traditional PIN-based authentication systems, offering a robust defence against unauthorized access, card skimming, and identity theft. Leveraging the affordability and versatility of Raspberry Pi, the proposed solution provides a cost-effective and scalable framework adaptable to diverse ATM infrastructures. Through a combination of facial recognition and fingerprint scanning, users can securely access ATM services, ensuring a seamless yet highly secure transaction experience. Furthermore, the implementation of this biometric solution not only enhances security but also enhances user convenience, eliminating the need for physical cards or memorized PINs. The Biometric Fortress represents a significant stride towards fortifying ATM systems against evolving security threats, promising a safer and more reliable future for banking transactions worldwide.

articleTitle: AID-UP: A Platform to Connect NGOs and Volunteer Teachers
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Different implementation choices are presented and a basic model application user interface of the NGO volunteer resource matching application is offered. The article concludes that in order to quickly build a prototype application and thoroughly test the interface with end users, a set of tools for rapid application development should be employed.This paper offers you resource data and applications for NGOs and volunteers which are adequate. Through volunteer networking, non-governmental organizations are being recognized as one of the most vital means of delivering needed services to their local communities. In a scenario when the number of competitors is constantly growing, non-governmental organizations (NGOs) are moving around different styles to become more flexible and innovative. The presence of new ways and sources in which volunteers and technologies can be involved can be used to provide a remedy for the difficulties that will undoubtedly come in years to come.The study investigates if leveraging new technologies could enhance the non-governmental organization's ability to connect with prospective volunteers. You may think of this research as a pilot project for creating an app that matches volunteer resources. The concept behind the application is that volunteers should actively search for possible volunteer activities.

Author Keywords: Common platform for NGOs and Volunteers

articleTitle: Job Hunt Mobile Application for Hiring Skilled Labour
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: A dichotomy exists between small-scale and large-scale corporations in the dynamic landscape of industries and businesses. Individuals with limited educational backgrounds and a basic understanding of computers and English often find their niche in small-scale businesses. However, for business owners in this sector, the challenge lies in sourcing suitable workers who meet their specific requirements. Addressing this gap, our proposed app aims to revolutionize employment by creating opportunities for individuals with modest educational backgrounds. The envisioned app serves as a comprehensive platform that connects recruiters with potential employees and harmonizes the divergent needs of both parties. Business owners can effortlessly present their job requirements within the app, allowing job seekers to browse and find suitable opportunities. This symbiotic relationship facilitates employment creation and fosters a mutually beneficial environment for both recruiters and employees.

articleTitle: Parkinson’s Disease Detection System Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: "Parkinson’s disease is a chronic neurological disorder that has a major impact on an individual’s motor functioning and has greatly impacted the quality of life due to debilitating symptoms, yet complex etiologies involving genetic and environmental elements. In this work, a speech dataset’s ability to predict Parkinson’s disease using machine learning(ML) approaches is examined. We evaluated eight machine learning(ML) models, namely: Linear Regression (LR), Logistic Regression (LOR), Random Forest (RF), SVM, Decision Tree (DT), XGBoost (XGB), Neural Networks (NN), and AdaBoost (ADB). The challenge of class imbalance has been addressed with the Self-Organizing Map Undersampling (SOMUS) technique. The models were evaluated using Recall, Precision, and F1-score. Our results indicate that the XGBoost and Random-Forest classifiers performed best for parkinson’s disease detection. The study indicates that machine learning can be applied for the improvement of diagnosis at an early stage and intervention in Parkinson’s disease."

articleTitle: Analyzing the Depths: Machine Learning Approaches to Understanding Depression
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Depression is a common mental health condition impacting millions worldwide, yet its complexities often hinder accurate diagnosis and effective treatment. This paper examines the role of machine learning in analyzing depression, with a focus on predicting symptoms and understanding their root causes. Various techniques, such as supervised learning, natural language processing (NLP), and neuroimaging, are reviewed for their potential in identifying patterns within depressive disorders. These methods offer promising insights into symptom prediction and a deeper understanding of the condition. However, challenges such as limited data, model complexity, and generalizability highlight the need for further research to improve these approaches.

articleTitle: Analyzing Bibliometric Systematic Reviews on Blockchain's Role in International E-Commerce Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Innovations in online platforms and shipping routes are driving the fast growth of international e-commerce system. Of these developments, blockchain technology is particularly noteworthy since it has the ability to completely transform management methods in a number of different industrial sectors by providing visibility, transparency, and disintermediation. Blockchain is still in its infancy, but with creative industrial applications, it has the potential to improve operational efficiency in international e-commerce supply chains. This research uses bibliometric analysis to methodically investigate how blockchain technology might improve SCM for international E-commerce. Through the application Through the utilization of Utilizing Vos Viewer for network and co-word analysis, the study finds cooperative relationships within the research corpus of articles taken from the Web of Science database between 2013 and 2021. Analyzing the relationships between international electronic commerce platforms and data governance is a special emphasis of this investigation, the results show how blockchain can help international supply chain management. Applying solutions powered by blockchain in these scenarios has the potential to yield significant insights for both industry professionals and academic scholars. Furthermore, by utilizing blockchain technology to improve supply chain management for global e-commerce, this research seeks to provide insights that can direct future engineering and research endeavors.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization for USB/IP (Universal Serial Bus/Internet Protocol) Network
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: There is a huge rise in the number of USB devices available these days, so is the need to access these devices remotely. This motivates the development of USB/IP (USB over Internet Protocol) solutions. However, the network speed of USB/IP remains a concern. This work addresses the important need for enhancing the performance of USB/IP networks. We explore two techniques to improve the network performance namely VPN Optimization and Port Forwarding. VPN Optimization achieves maximum variation of 20s. In Remote Port Forwarding it took lesser time by at most 8s and maximum difference 29s in Local Port Forwarding.

articleTitle: Fire and Smoke Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: From large urban areas to dense forests, fires and wildfires are a major threat around the world. While the detection system can reduce these hazards, their high cost, low alarms, need for special construction, and overall lack of reliability have hindered mass adoption. This research focuses on manipulating electricity and smoke in images through the power of deep learning. Deep learning using neural networks has been incredibly successful in many fields, including computer vision. Our goal is to solve the limitations of current systems and provide effective and efficient solutions to premature electricity and smog in many areas, ultimately saving countless lives and resources.

articleTitle: Deep Acne: Advancing Automated Acne Identification through Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Acne vulgaris is a common dermatological illness that impacts a considerable segment of the population, especially during adolescence. Effective acne medication and management rely on the timely and accurate detection of lesions. The classification of skin lesions is a task in medical image analysis where deep learning methodologies have shown promising outcomes in recent years. This research seeks to assess the efficacy of various advanced object detection models, including Faster R-CNN, R-FCN, SDD, and YOLO, for the automated categorization of acne lesions in dermatological images. YOLO emerges as the best-performing model (with 97.3% accuracy) for acne classification based on these results, closely followed by R-FCN. This study contributes to the development of automated acne classification systems, which can assist dermatologists in clinical practice, telemedicine consultations, and large-scale skin disease screening programs.

articleTitle: Sentinel Exploring the Effectiveness of Autonomous IoT Based Security Robots in Enhancing Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This paper introduces an IIoT driven intelligent Security based robot "SENTINEL", leveraging an Arduino Uno, camera unit, ultrasonic sensor, motor controller, motors,The envisioned robot is engineered to autonomously survey a specified area, capturing images and videos with the camera unit. The ultrasonic sensor identifies obstacles to avert collisions, alerting the user. The robot maneuvers and alters its course through the motor controller and motors, managed by an Arduino Uno. This system finds utility in various domains, including surveillance and security, enhancing security-based system. It is economically developed, broadening its accessibility for future used. The system's deployment has undergone testing, demonstrating proficiency in recognizing and responding to environmental cues. A web- based interface facilitates remote control and monitoring by users.

articleTitle: Study of Stock Price Trends for Indian Share Market vs American Share Market Using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Stock market trading is a pivotal financial activity, fraught with uncertainty and volatility. Investors constantly seek methods to predict future trends, aiming to minimize losses and maximize profits. Achieving complete accuracy in forecasting remains a challenge, yet progress within Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) has prompted researchers to investigate several methods for predicting stock prices.This employs Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models to forecast stock prices of five Indian and five American companies across varying time horizons. In this underscores the need for customized predictive models to navigate the unique complexities of forecasting within different market contexts.

articleTitle: Histopathological Breast Cancer Detection: A Vision Transformer and Attention-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This study focuses on the critical area of early breast cancer diagnosis, an effort that is vital for saving lives. Breast cancer is known to be extremely deadly and presents a substantial challenge because it typically does not cause any symptoms until it has progressed to an advanced stage. Histopathologic images are extremely useful in this situation because they offer fine-grained microscopic views of tissue samples. However, because of the minute differences in cellular morphology and tissue structure, it is especially difficult to discern between malignant and non-cancerous tissue in these images. We used the Vision Transformers(ViT) model, a transformer architecture with a self-attention mechanism, that can support efforts in early cancer diagnosis. We study how ViT’s attention processes may effectively extract subtle features from histopathologic images to improve classification accuracy. In addition, we examine fine-tuning approaches designed expressly for medical image processing to guarantee the best possible performance of the ViT model in this particular field. After extensive testing and validation, our ViT-based system shows encouraging results with 93% training accuracy and 91% robust testing accuracy. These remarkable results highlight the revolutionary potential of Vision Transformers in transforming the detection of breast cancer and related activities, providing a ray of hope for better patient and healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction: Machine Learning Models Enhanced by Harmony Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The Harmony Search (HS) algorithm has been used in many applications, including engineering, excavation, epidemiology, object recognition, stock price prediction, genetic analysis, and structural design optimization, all derived from the improvisation process in musicians. The study covers the application of the HS algorithm for a predictive model of diabetes with its parameter tuning and optimization process of the model. In performing the research, a dataset will be used that contains data of information regarding demographic data, clinical metrics, and lifestyle attributes of people with and without diabetes. The most important features such as age, BMI, blood pressure, and glucose level will be treated as input variables. The HS algorithm will optimize the model parameters to develop the best model for the process of prediction of diabetes. The research has four parts: preparing, choosing features, training models, HS-driven upgrade, and checking results. The best model with K-NN beat all basic models in accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. This shows good risk evaluation and early diabetes detection. This article contributes new contributions to emerging areas of diabetes prediction through novel avenues in model optimization. Specifically, this shows the efficacy of the HS algorithm, which improves the performance of predictive models. In that sense, this improves the ability to do an accurate and reliable risk evaluation of diabetes in clinical applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Robustness of Remote Heart Rate Estimation In Varied Illumination Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This research enhances ML models for remote heart rate estimation under varied illumination using an extensive rPPG dataset. We employ two approaches: feature analysis with CSV data and deep learning-based image analysis. For CSV data, advanced ML algorithms (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVR) are used, comparing classical methods like ICA with our Feature Correlation Model. For image data, a custom CNN is developed and benchmarked against traditional rPPG methods like CHROM and Green. This evaluation highlights the effectiveness of these techniques in detecting subtle skin color changes for heart rate monitoring.Our proposed architecture combines insights from CSV and image data analyses to create a robust framework for non-contact heart rate monitoring. It uses a dual-model approach: the Feature Correlation Model leverages CSV data to highlight physiological signal interactions, while the CNN processes image data to capture spatial-temporal features. This integration enhances predictive capabilities and adaptability across diverse conditions, advancing rPPG technology in healthcare, telemedicine, fitness tracking, and human-computer interaction. The goal is to improve prediction accuracy and reliability, addressing the complex dynamics between physiological features and varying illumination, and setting a new standard for remote photoplethysmography applications.

articleTitle: Recommendation System Evaluation with Various Similarity Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Movie recommendation systems become an integral part for assisting users in discovering relevant and enjoyable content in today's vast digital media landscape. Evaluating the effectiveness of these recommendation systems is essential to ensure accurate and personalized recommendations. Our methodology involves the selection of diverse similarity metrics, including cosine similarity, Pearson correlation, and Jaccard similarity, among others. We conduct experiments using a movielens 100K dataset of movie ratings, employing standard evaluation criteria such as MAE, RMSE, Precision and Recall. Through rigorous experimentation and analysis, we demonstrate the performance of these similarity metrics in terms of recommendation quality and computational efficiency. The results of our study reveal insights into the strengths and limitations of different similarity metrics in movie recommendation systems. We observe variations in performance across metrics, with certain metrics demonstrating superior accuracy or coverage under specific conditions. By analyzing various metrics and their impact on the performance of recommendation systems we can conclude that in similar available scenario which similarity metrics will do better. Jaccard Coefficient and cosine similarity performing well in this context while Euclidean and Manhattan metrics are showing lower performance.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Approach to Admissions using Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: College Admission Management Software is a web-enabled software designed to manage the admission process of an institution. An institution’s numerous departments, including administration, accounts, the student section, and many more specialized modules, are all connected by College Admission Management Software. It is a straightforward yet highly effective single-joint integrated platform. It has become evident over time that nearly all educational institutions still handle the admission process and critical academic notifications in offline mode. Important academic and administrative disclosures are currently made by hand using paper and pen, which takes a lot of time and is a major hassle to keep track of everywhere. In addition to being time-consuming, this paper-pen method is ineffective, and maintaining the paperwork and records is challenging. This web-based technology will allow us to complete the admission process with ease without even going to the college, thus making the process more effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Modelling a movie recommendation system using a mixed classification method
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to enhance the accuracy and reliability of movie recommendation systems (MRS) by addressing common challenges such as the cold start problem, data sparsity, and malicious attacks. This study introduces a mixed machine learning approach, combining traditional classification techniques with advanced models like autoencoders and Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs). By incorporating trust metrics into the recommendation process, the system aims to provide more personalized and dependable movie suggestions. The methodology involves using a hybrid classifier that integrates Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machines, autoencoders, and RBMs to improve recommendation precision. The results demonstrate that the inclusion of trust-based algorithms significantly enhances the recommendation accuracy, especially in scenarios with limited data. The proposed model outperformed traditional methods, achieving higher validation accuracy and effectively addressing the cold start problem. The integration of trust metrics with RBM further improved the system's performance, achieving an accuracy of 93.4%. This study concludes that hybrid machine learning approaches, combined with trust-aware mechanisms, offer a robust solution to the challenges faced by conventional MRS, providing a foundation for future research in developing more efficient and reliable recommendation systems.

articleTitle: HEARTFIT: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: “Worldwide, heart disease is the leading killer. Several forms of cutting-edge medical technology are utilized to treat cardiac illnesses. The biggest issue in hospitals is that many doctors lack the necessary training and experience to manage patients. This leads to them making poor decisions, which unfortunately often result in patient deaths. Hospitals are pivotal in automating diagnosis through the use of data mining and machine learning algorithms to tackle these issues with heart disease forecasts. By examining the patient’s various vital signs, it is possible to forecast the course of heart disease. Various techniques including ANNs, decision trees, KNN, and naïve Bayes can be employed for the purpose of cardiac disease prediction. Several factors have been employed in the prediction of cardiac disease. Gender, age, and cerebral palsy are the three criteria that must be taken into account. Cerebral palsy (CP), blood pressure, gender, fasting blood sugar test (FBS), etc. For this research, we drew on an integrated dataset. Using the same dataset, we have created five distinct approaches to forecast cardiac illness. A number of algorithms have been put into use, including ANN, Decision trees, Naive Bayes, k-nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest. Finding the most accurate method for forecasting the occurrence of heart disease from a variety of health indicators is the focus of this investigation. Based on the results of the experiment, Naïve Bayes achieved the best accuracy rate of 88%.”

articleTitle: Automated Monitoring of Hydroponic System using IoT and Cloud based Technology for Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Hydroponics agriculture is a soilless cultivation method in which plants are grown solely with nutrients and water. It provides a solution to the growing scarcity of agricultural land. A hydroponics farming setup based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology is designed and developed in this paper. Our system uses a deep-water culture type of hydroponic system which is the process of plant making by putting the plant roots into a mixture of nutrient-rich and oxygenated water. There are two water tanks namely the plantation tank and the treatment tank. The plantation tank holds the sowed seeds. The treatment tank gets water from the first tank and treats it with buffer and nutrients. The system consists of a total of three sensors in the Plantation tank - pH sensor, TDS sensor and DS18B20 temperature sensor. The sensors are connected to ESP32 microcontroller. Results: The proposed setup monitors Potential of Hydrogen (pH), Temperature, and Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) levels. The developed setup includes an IoT feature that allows the system to be monitored remotely via a mobile application. Thus, except for sowing and harvesting, the proposed hydroponic setup requires lesser human intervention. It aids in ensuring proper moisture content based on environmental conditions resulting into efficient plant growth, as well as continuous monitoring and nutrient supply based on crop growth.

articleTitle: Land Cover Analysis and Change Detection: Comprehensive Study with Linear Regression Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Land cover analysis and change detection are critical components of environmental monitoring and management. This paper explores methodologies, technologies, and applications related to the assessment of land cover changes over time. Using Geographic map techniques and Geographic Information System (GIS) tools, we analyze satellite imagery using maps to provide insights into land cover dynamics. Additionally, we employ linear regression for predicting future land cover changes based on historical data. A core component of the analysis is the use of linear regression models to predict future land cover changes. These models are developed using historical land cover data to forecast trends and potential future scenarios. Our study provides a detailed examination of land cover transformations, highlighting significant shifts such as urban expansion, deforestation, and agricultural development. The predictive models offer valuable insights into future land cover trends, enabling better planning and decision-making. This study focuses on identifying significant changes in land use, mainly focusing on Urbanization, Vegetation and Agriculture, Barrens Land and Deforestation.

articleTitle: Fuzzy based Mamdani Inference System for Botnet Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The word "botnet" blends the words "robot" and "network". The bot master manages the botnet, which allows for remote bot management over the network. The bot master communicates with the bots (infected computers) via IRC C&C channels, from which the bots receive commands and instructions to carry out certain tasks. It spreads to other computers, forming a network. The present paper discusses Mamdani Fuzzy Inference System (FIS) to detect botnets. In contrast to Boolean "true and false" reasoning for fuzzy logic botnet detection, the paper adopts a "degree of truth" approach. The mamdani fuzzy inference system uses the idea of partial truth - where a fact's value might range from totally true to entirely untrue. MATLAB has been used to implement the botnet detection using mamdani fuzzy inference system. The fuzzy regulations were recently adjusted as the data parameters have changed.

articleTitle: Blockchain Meets Cloud: Revolutionizing Secure and Decentralized Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Cloud computing is a very efficient technique that is very helpful in storing and accessing data through the internet. With several features like scalability, reliability, on-demand access, and remote accessibility it also raises some privacy concerns for the important data. To address these concerns, blockchain technology provides a secure environment for user data. Hence, blockchain integrated with cloud computing helps to improve security in various application areas like healthcare industries, real estate, voting, financial sectors, etc. The review continues by underlining the requirement for additional research and potential opportunities for further advancements in this domain. This study provides a comparison study of current research based on multiple factors such as privacy, security, encryption methods, authentication, cryptography, and access control mechanisms. This underscores the need to incorporate blockchain technology into cloud environments to provide robust security measures. Some challenges are also discussed in this study that come with blockchain technology and in the future, more powerful or secure techniques can also be discovered in this domain.

articleTitle: Transforming Cardiovascular Disease Management through Advanced AI and ML-Driven Predictive Modeling and Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This groundbreaking paper, driven by AI and ML, seeks to revolutionize heart disease management globally through data visualization and predictive modeling. Given the persistent prevalence of cardiac disease, proactive measures are imperative, with early diagnosis pivotal for effective intervention. Employing advanced AI and ML techniques, our primary goal is to glean invaluable insights from extensive heart health datasets, utilizing sophisticated data visualization tools to enhance comprehension. In contrast to the current landscape of the medical field, which is abundant in data but often lacks robust analytical tools capable of discerning intricate patterns and trends, this research embarks on a journey into the realm of state-of-the-art discovery techniques housed within databases. The primary emphasis is directed towards the prediction of heart diseases, utilizing datasets traditionally confined to the realms of medical studies. A multitude of trials have been conducted, rigorously evaluating the efficacy of various predictive data mining methodologies on identical datasets. The findings underscore the superiority of decision trees over alternative techniques. While Bayesian classification occasionally demonstrates comparable accuracy to decision trees, methodologies such as KNN, neural networks, and classification generally exhibit inferior performance metrics. A significant discovery reveals that employing genetic methods to refine real data enhances the accuracy of both decision trees and Bayesian classification, resulting in remarkable outcomes conducive to heart disease prediction. The utilization of Pyplot, an indispensable tool within the matplotlib module, is vital for generating a diverse array of plots and graphs, spanning charts, histograms, scatter plots, and 3D charts.
