Key functionalities such as standardscaler(), expression distribution, and confusion matrix bolster the model's resilience. As this project reaches its apex, a comprehensive plan emerges, showcasing the model's precision and offering a nuanced insight into its predictive prowess. This holistic approach not only empowers healthcare providers by enhancing diagnostic precision but also fosters a deeper understanding of individual health among patients. Through the fusion of AI, ML, and advanced visualization techniques, our aim is to redefine the management of cardiovascular health, thus making a significant contribution to global well-being.

articleTitle: A CNN-Based Deep Learning Method for Accurate Restrain and Classification of Tomato Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Tomato leaf disease detection is an essential task in agriculture to maintain the health and productivity of tomato crops which are a significant component of the global food supply. In the past, diagnosis has involved a form of examination of organs, tissues, or samples by doctors or pathologists which can be a tiresome process and results from which are most of the time prone to high levels of error. Formally, for such tasks, this was performed manually; however, with the development of deep learning technologies, quantization of this process is being performed regularly to increase its efficiency. It is this survey that expects a synthesized picture of the current literature concerning the procedure that seeks to employ deep learning techniques to diagnose diseases affecting tomato leaves. The approaches used in the survey make it possible to achieve high accuracy rates of the deep learning models; some of the models are characterized by an accuracy of more than 95%; thus, can be applied to practical use in the agricultural industry. It also explains some of the issues like lack of supply of data, much complexity of the model and computational resources that are needed. Future research studies should therefore need to take up the issues pointed above and construct even larger databases and likewise try to incorporate the models in real time. Based on the review of literature this qualitative analysis gives an insight about the growing trends and patterns of using deep learning approach for detection of tomato leaf disease and the possibilities towards getting enlightened to further improvement in the agricultural technology in future.

articleTitle: 5G-LRVN: Latency Reduction Framework for SDVN using Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Vehicular networks provide the roadside connectivity and facilitate the requested information among users while driving. It connects a large number of vehicles with hierarchical infrastructure elements for the use of various vehicle control and the traffic control that is real-time. Applications demand better sharing of the information as the density of vehicles and information is increasing. The efficiency of information selection and the retrieval of traffic information is determined by decisions made in the past and present. When a driver uses the traffic and vehicle management program, this prevents extraneous information from getting in the way. By presenting a framework for the network of vehicles which makes use of SDN with 5G and fog computing, this research offers a safe information exchange paradigm that combines faster data transfer speeds with security.

articleTitle: Skin disease detection using Decision Tree and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Skin-related conditions are the most common health problems worldwide. Infections carry concealed risks that may lead to a spectrum of health challenges, encompassing both physical ailments and mental health disorders such as depression. In extreme instances, it has the potential to induce skin cancer. Manually diagnosing skin conditions by medical professionals is a laborious and subjective process. Thus, it is clear to patients and physicians that automatic skin disease prediction is necessary to enable quick treatment plans. The primary aim of this study is to predict whether a skin disease is benign or malignant. To reduce image noise, our approach utilizes Gaussian filtering. Subsequently, for each image contrast correlation energy and homogeneity was computed using GLCM- Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix. Machine learning algorithms were applied for classification: Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision Tree (DT). We found that Decision Tree (DT) attained a classification accuracy of 91%, which is higher related to SVM.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Travel Planning: An Image Based Destination Recognition and Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Due to the abundance of information available online and the wide range of possibilities available, our preparation has become more difficult and time-consuming. This is especially true given that every visitor has different interests and preferred destinations in addition to tour-specific limitations like vaccination records and travel restrictions due to pandemics. A number of travel agencies and organizations have sprung up with more advanced internet services in an attempt to take advantage of the growing global travel market by employing technology to provide travelers with relevant recommendations. However, these systems often use a destination-based recommendation strategy and are sold in packages with little room for modification to account for the tastes of individual travelers. In order to overcome these restrictions. With the use of artificial intelligence-powered picture recognition, our TravelGaze system can now identify destinations from user-uploadedimages, marking a significant advancement in travel technology. In addition to recognition, the system offers customized trip suggestions that include neighboring lodging options, eateries, art galleries, and current weather information. The solution improves destination recognition accuracy and revolutionizes travel planning by utilizing cutting-edge AI algorithms. This paper offers insights for developers and stakeholders looking to reinvent how consumers explore and plan their travels, adding to the ongoing conversation on intelligent travel solutions.

articleTitle: A Raspberry Pi 4 and Arduino-based Automated Intercom Door Lock System
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This work aims at building a working model for a complete intercom door lock system using Arduino and Raspberry Pi. The goal has been to unite the best of Raspberry Pi and Arduino in a single application. While the microcontroller on the Arduino is quite simple and runs just one program at the maximum speed capacity, the microprocessor utilised in Raspberry Pi is used in computers and phones and on which we usually install an operating system to run a variety of programs to perform different tasks. Arduino is better suited for controlling the hardware components. On the other hand, the Raspberry Pi is better suited for software applications that demand more processing power. Certain hardware functionalities can only be implemented using the Arduino because although the GPIO panel on the Raspberry Pi is great, it is pretty limited compared to the Arduino pins. The link between Raspberry Pi and Arduino is set up via serial communication. Components such as RGB LED, buzzer, push button, LCD, and motor, are attached to the Arduino board. The Raspberry Pi runs a Python script to receive requests to open the door and directs the captured images to the owner to receive further instructions. The corresponding course of action is followed according to the option chosen by the owner.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Image Captioning using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Image caption generation involves automatically describing images with syntactically and semantically accurate entences. This process necessitates recognizing important objects, their attributes, and their relationships with in an image. Our proposed model utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM) networks to achieve this. The CNN extracts intricate visual features from input images, while the LSTM generates contextually coherent captions. Leveraging pre-trained models for object detection, our system seamlessly integrates object recognition with caption generation. Extensively trained on large scale image-caption flickr 8k datasets, our model learns to connect written descriptions with graphic components to generate accurate and meaningful captions. This research significantly advances the realms of computer vision and natural language processing.

articleTitle: Unveiling Geospatial Dynamics: A Comprehensive Exploration of Location-Based Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Exploratory Analysis of Geolocational Data is a vital aspect of understanding spatial patterns and trends in diverse fields, ranging from urban planning to environmental science. This study delves into the methodologies and insights gained from the exploration of geolocational data sets. By employing advanced data visualization techniques and statistical tools, we uncover hidden patterns, correlations, and anomalies within spatial data. The exploration begins with a comprehensive overview of the data sources and collection methods, emphasizing the importance of geospatial context. We discuss the challenges associated with geolocational data, including issues related to accuracy, privacy, and data integration. Through a series of case studies, we illustrate how exploratory analysis can be applied to different domains, providing valuable insights for decision-makers and researchers. Furthermore, this paper explores the significance of geospatial visualization in conveying complex information effectively. We examine various visualization techniques, including heatmaps, choropleth maps, and spatial clustering, highlighting their applications in uncovering spatial trends. Additionally, we address the integration of temporal aspects into geolocational analysis, allowing for a dynamic understanding of spatial patterns over time. In conclusion, this exploratory analysis serves as a foundation for leveraging geolocational data for informed decision-making. By understanding the inherent characteristics and challenges of such data, researchers and practitioners can unlock valuable insights that contribute to advancements in various fields.

articleTitle: Enhanced Rainfall Prediction: Leveraging Ensembling Models for Maximum Forecasting Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Many important fields rely on accurate rainfall predictions, including agriculture, water resource management, and emergency preparation. The many nonlinear interactions included in weather data are notoriously difficult for traditional approaches to grasp. Agriculture, water resource management, and disaster preparation are just a few of the many sectors that might benefit greatly from accurate rainfall predictions. Because meteorological data is both complicated and dynamic, traditional methods often get it wrong. Recent years have seen encouraging results in the use of machine learning (ML) approaches, especially ensemble models, to enhance the precision and consistency of precipitation forecasts. This research provides a new method for predicting precipitation using an ensemble of ML models. The ensemble model EERP algorithm combines the predictions of numerous base learners to create a more reliable and accurate forecast. Decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting machines, neural networks, and other ML approaches serve as the ensemble’s base learners. Assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach and then compare it with some existing classifiers in which the proposed classifier gave the best accuracy when compared with the other i.e., 96 %.

articleTitle: BeanClassify: Convolutional Neural Networks for Coffee Bean Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In the coffee industry, bean classification is essential for quality assurance and management. Conventional approaches are frequently laborious and subjective, and they mostly rely on human expertise. Article provide a unique method for automatically classifying coffee beans crop from photos using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The article gathered a varied dataset that included high-quality photos of many coffee bean varieties and grades. To improve feature extraction and standardize the images, preprocessing approaches were used. An architecture was created, with several convolutional layers, max-pooling, and fully linked layers coming after. The dataset was separated into training, validation, and test sets to train and assess the CNN model. Performance measures like recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score were computed to gauge how well the model classified coffee beans. The test results show that the suggested method for classifying coffee beans is effective. The model demonstrated its potential for useful implementation in the coffee business by achieving high accuracy and outperforming conventional methods. To improve classification efficiency and accuracy, future work may entail investigating new image processing methods and further refining the CNN architecture.

articleTitle: TalkifyPy: The Pythonic Voice Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed tremendous developments in text-to-speech (TTS) technology, which is now essential for a wide range of applications, such as virtual assistants, entertainment, and accessibility solutions. This proposed system provides a thorough introduction to Python- based text-to-speech synthesis. The use of Python libraries for Text-to-Speech (TTS) is described in the paper, with particular emphasis on gTTS (Google Text-to-Speech) and pyttsx3 packages. It provides a step-by-step tutorial for creating a rudimentary TTS system while exploring the underlying ideas and techniques of TTS synthesis. The study also examines the difficulties and prospective applications of TTS technology in the future, highlighting its potential for advancement and incorporation into a range of practical uses. The study explores the technical aspects of Python-based TTS systems implementation, empowering developers to comprehend and make efficient use of these instruments. The suggested TTS system is made simple to replicate and integrate into a variety of techniques by providing code examples and real-world applications. This study article is to support the development and broad implementation of TTS technology, promoting innovation in the domain of natural language processing and human-computer interaction, by offering a thorough examination of TTS synthesis with Python.

articleTitle: Key Technologies for Security with different Performance Parameters in Mobile Agent System
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The world is moving forward with technology as mobile agents are the initials for creating a chain of connections from one hope to another. And because of this, technology has a kind of meaning. Due to the many attacks in the middle, the channels for transferring information from one device to another are not secure. Due to these security concerns, there is a need to explore the major classified security technologies for the smooth operation of healthy communication. The paper is designed to create a comprehensive view of security coverage in technology. Faced with many challenges in real time applications or data transfer, the system has also been advanced by implementing many security algorithms and techniques. These security methods are encapsulated in cryptographic mechanisms. The main role in the system is only that of the host, who controls the channel and exchanges information from one place to another. So, the burden of lack of security also falls on the host. The host must be advanced somehow to avoid smart attacks. Here the host requests a secure channel to exchange information from different devices. Before going into depth, one needs to look at the security measures broadly for better understanding, the paper is communicating to everyone here.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Power-Efficient Communication Technique (PECT) for Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The evaluation of the Power-Efficient Communication Technique (PECT) involves a two-step process. First, a custom C program calculates optimal transmission powers for each sensor node based on the network size (Qn) and data packet frequency (FPkt), aiming to minimize energy consumption while ensuring reliable communication. These powers are then implemented in the Castalia network simulator, chosen for its accurate modeling of wireless channels and energy consumption. Simulations track metrics like energy use and successful packet transmission. Results show PECT maintains over 90% data packet reception, though -25 dBm power sees increased packet loss. PECT achieves similar power consumption to -15 dBm, with only 1.82% higher consumption, and offers a 36.7% energy savings per node compared to 0 dBm, especially notable with Qn = 8. Beyond the Low Transmission Power Duty (LTPD), CPU and peripheral power consumption rise significantly at higher frequencies. PECT’s simplicity, portability, and node independence make it suitable for any network topology, demonstrating its potential for energy-efficient WSN communication.

articleTitle: Community Detection and Modularity Analysis in Stack Overflow Network Graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Stack overflow is the largest online platform for learning and exchanging question answers for the computer programmers. On Stack Overflow, participants share topics that help programming learner, professionals, and experts. Using specific words or tags to describe a question makes it easier to explore the site. Tags are helpful in finding answers faster and connect with others who know about that topic. In this study we have chosen the stack overflow data set where in the first step exploratory data analysis is performed. Community detection algorithm is applied on 115 number of nodes and 490 number of links of the stack overflow dataset. In this paper, we use different community detection techniques and centrality metrics to analyses community detection in computer programming classes offered on Stack Overflow, a popular platform. To be more precise, we examine the community structure in the Stack Overflow courses using the Girvan-Newman, Louvain, Walk-trap, and Greedy modular community algorithms.Additionally, we assess the modularity of the identified communities by utilizing the Girvan-Newman algorithm, which measures the degree of network segmentation into modules. Furthermore, we provide valuable insights into the organization and clustering of users in online learning platforms, facilitating the development of targeted interventions and community management strategies to enhance the learning experience.

articleTitle: Plant Disease detection using Machine learning and CNN on leaf images
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This paper proposes a system for detection of the diseases in plants using machine learning and image processing technique to analyze the images of leaves and fruits. Leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and various machine learning approaches, our system aims to accurately detect and classify plant diseases for improved agricultural management. We draw inspiration from previous studies, incorporating methodologies such as data augmentation, feature extraction, and outlier identification to enhance detection accuracy and efficiency. The proposed system is evaluated using diverse datasets, encompassing a range of plant species and disease types, to ensure robustness and generalization. Through experimentation, we demonstrate the efficiency of CNNs and algorithms of machine learning in detecting diseases and classifying plant species, highlighting their potential for real-world applications in agriculture. Additionally, we focused on the importance of selection of dataset, evaluation metrics, and optimization of model for achieving reliable disease detection results.

articleTitle: Demystifying Predictive Maintenance: Achieving Transparency through Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Predictive maintenance is a crucial factor of commercial enterprise operations that ensures and minimizes the failure rate of machinery and equipment. however, the shortcomings of many machine-mastering fashions have hindered the giant use of AI-powered predictive protection answers, raising issues regarding transparency, duty, and acceptance. This study proposes a unique approach to deal with the demanding situations related to enterprise continuity prediction by way of developing an interpretable artificial intelligence-based tool. The primary goal is to enhance the transparency and explainability of AI-driven maintenance decisions via the integration of descriptive and predictive modeling strategies. The proposed framework leverages advanced machine learning algorithms and carries both nearby and worldwide interpretability techniques, along with LIME, SHAP, and characteristic importance evaluation. furthermore, we propose to establish overall performance benchmarks for the AI system and demonstrate its potential to generate significant explanations, thereby allowing professionals to understand the underlying logic and key elements influencing the predictions. in addition, this study examines the effect of AI transparency on fostering belief, responsibility, and the adoption of AI systems in the maintenance forecasting enterprise.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Real Time Chat Application for User Friendly Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Given that business and social relations in the contemporary world are vastly mediated by digital communication, it is imperative to evoke effective and client-oriented chat applications. The following work tries of creating a chat application, which was programmed using python. The mobile app is a synergy towards the societal shift in the meeting and greeting of people via the internet using a safe and inclusive, service-packed approach. Making use of features such as real-time communication, the application guarantees the immediacy of the communication making the interaction between users active and engaging. Possibly the most important factor, security is provided in the context of encryption, ensuring users’ data is securely encrypted from one end to the other and authentication. Features like extensive settings allow the user to control the look and feel of the chat and Python supports numerous platforms to run this chat. This paper embodies a work of multidisciplinary nature; team members with proficiency in python programming, UI/UX designing, and database setup. Pre- and post-launch test documentation on the Chat App and feedback from the users show the effort that has been invested in creating a sound communication tool that is fun to use.

articleTitle: Detailed Explanation: Optimizing COVID-19 CT-Scan Classification with Feature Engineering and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This research delves into the optimization of a genetic algorithm for the categorization of COVID-19 CT scan images through the amalgamation of a high-level grayscale cooccurrence matrix (GCLM) elimination technique, color consistency vector (CCV), and discrete wavelet transform (DWT). The primary objective of this combination is to enhance the discriminatory capabilities of specific criteria, thereby elevating the precision of the machine learning model. Specifically, the crafting of the classification was executed through Fisher-KNN (F-KNN), linear support vector machine (L-SVM), and the Fisher visual decision tree (F-Tree).Genetic algorithms were employed for targeted selection to amplify the efficiency of these models in accurately identifying COVID-19 samples within CT images. The outcomes of this investigation offer valuable insights for continuous endeavors aimed at enhancing COVID-19 diagnostics by integrating architecture, genetic algorithms, and machine learning models. Notably, among the proposed methodologies, the fuzzy tree classifier achieved an impressive accuracy of 93.55%, while alternative classifiers such as Naive Bayes, L-SVM, and F-KNN attained accuracies of 92.6%, 92.12%, and 92.33% respectively. This research underscores the significance of leveraging advanced computational techniques in the field of medical imaging for improved disease detection and classification. The fusion of genetic algorithms with machine learning frameworks unveils an exciting pathway to boost the precision and effectiveness of COVID-19 detection via CT imaging. The results of this research play a significant role in the evolving conversation surrounding the incorporation of cutting-edge technologies in the medical field, aiming for enhanced disease control and accurate diagnosis.

articleTitle: Securing WSN-IOT with Firefly Algorithm and Machine Learning for Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has seen significant problems with network intrusion detection. Existing systems often cannot consistently achieve maximum performance on many classification tasks. To improve network intrusion detection effectiveness, we provide a novel intrusion detection technique in this research. This work employs the Firefly Algorithm in conjunction with a synergistic machine learning method to enhance the security of wireless sensor networks (WSNs) and the Internet of Things. The proposed technique much exceeds expectations in terms of improving intrusion detection accuracy. This method offers a novel approach to security-related system optimization by combining machine learning with the Firefly Algorithm. In contrast to the NSL-KDD dataset, the proposed model is 99.44% accurate. In this work, we created a model to enhance intrusion detection for WSN-IoT systems by fusing machine learning with the Firefly Algorithm.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Prediction using Linear Regression and Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Corona virus illness (COVID-19), a respiratory condition affecting people in many countries, has swiftly spread to pandemic levels. A respiratory infection (like influenza) is the outcome of the condition, and signs and symptoms include breathing difficulty, cough, cold, and fever. The prediction of new COVID-19 occurrences is not an easy task. This work aims to improve the time-series prediction model based on linear regression by balancing the dataset through oversampling and choosing features using the discrete wavelet transform. Using WHO official data on the COVID-19 pandemic globally, the revised model (ELR) was evaluated and compared with numerous cutting-edge, contemporary algorithms. The ELR model surpassed the current Linear regression model (accuracy=94.7%, MAPE=0.052, MPE=0.486, MAE=0.029, and RMSE=8.383) with accuracy=98.4%, MAPE=0.016, MPE=0.308, MAE=0.016, and RMSE=3.383. ELR model is an effective, quick and easy method to predict COVID-19 trends using open-access data. Our research provides a workable solution for imbalanced Covid-19 data classification with limited sample numbers and high-dimensional characteristics. The suggested method may offer a theoretical foundation for computer-assisted diagnostics and allow for the prediction of any illness that may affect patients during upcoming pandemics.

articleTitle: Integrating Reliable AI to Boost Blockchain's Transparency and Accountability
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The power of blockchain technology to provide decentralized networks accountability and transparency has transformed several industries. However, there are limitations to traditional blockchain systems, like data tampering and insufficient real-time validation capabilities. The study proposes a ground-breaking approach to solving these issues by integrating AI algorithms to enhance accountability and transparency in blockchain ecosystems. The proposed system improves consensus processes, identifies abnormalities, and validates transactions in real-time by using AI-driven methods. Using rigorous data gathering, pre-processing, model selection, and continuous review, the system outperforms existing systems in terms of fraud detection accuracy, false positives and negatives, and transaction validation performance. Through a significant increase in security, scalability, and efficiency, the results indicate the potential of AI-driven blockchain solutions to support trust and reliability in transaction processing and fraud detection. The proposed system outperforms existing systems with a 95% fraud detection rate, a 5% false positive rate, and a 5% false negative rate. Furthermore, the scalability and efficacy of the proposed AI-enhanced blockchain system are demonstrated by the significant improvements in transaction validation performance across a variety of transaction volumes.

articleTitle: E-MAIL Classifier Using NLP and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In today’s digital communication, email classification is an essential responsibility. Emails are arranged and classified according to their objective and content. Using artificial intelligence and machine learning, this project aims to develop an accurate email categorization system that can discriminate between emails categorized as spam and those that are not. It is planned that a training is performed on a wide range of content of email in order to identify the patterns that differentiate different message types.The evaluation of the performance is performed on accuracy and precision and contrasted with other email classification algorithms currently in use to demonstrate how effective and efficient it is. To determine which strategy is optimal, the accuracy of these approaches will be evaluated. To guarantee minimal preparation and optimize accuracy, a variety of algorithms, such as Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and XGBoost, will be used. Individual words are regarded as features in the Naive Bayes classification system. The objective of this project is to strengthen email management overall for users and to progress email classification systems.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the performance of different Energy Efficient Routing Protocols for Network Security and Protection Strategy in Homogeneous and Heterogeneous WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is comprised of 100 units which have been dispersed randomly around an area and used to sense data. The ability to sense, store, broadcast data, and use energy resources, but they are not rechargeable or changeable. To extend the lifespan of WSNs, energy-efficient protocols should be developed because of the restricted energy resources of sensors. It is crucial to create a routing protocol since it enables us to maximize the network's lifespan through energy efficiency. We must address many researchers' efforts to increase the WSN’s energy efficiency using diverse strategies in this systematic literature study.Mainly In this methodical study of the literature, we must talk about the key problems and the suggested routing protocol that they raise. Additionally, the approach used in this thorough literature evaluation is discussed in this publication. More than that, this SLR also discussed the outcomes in terms of the electronic (digital) libraries, significant involvement in this evaluation of the literature, and the methods employed in these routing protocols of the network.

articleTitle: The Evolutionary Arms Race - Safeguarding Financial Stability through Advanced Fraud Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In the wake of the exceptional surge in virtual transactions, the global economic sector faces an heightened danger of credit card fraud. This assessment paper examines the ancient evolution of fraud detection strategies, highlighting the constraints of traditional safety features. Drawing from great research, the have a look at emphasizes the importance of superior technologies like device learning, Block Chain, and large records analytics in strengthening economic protection. It additionally discusses the challenges and techniques worried in integrating these technologies into present structures. Thru rigorous checking out, the paper evaluates the effectiveness of these structures in figuring out and preventing various styles of fraud, emphasizing their critical function in building accept as true with and resilience in economic structures global. Moreover, by addressing modern-day challenges and emerging threats, the assessment contributes to efforts to decorate the integrity of financial transactions and set up an robust economic atmosphere for the society. Ultimately, it advocates for ongoing innovation in fraud detection strategies to hold and decorate the security of the global economic network.

articleTitle: Efficient Heart Disease Risk Management: A CNN-based Approach for Automated Prediction using Retinal Fundus Image
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Despite established risk factors such as diabetes, heart disease remains a major health problem. Early diagnosis of heart disease is essential for successful prevention and treatment. Traditional assessment methods can be time-consuming and complex, highlighting the need for automated detection systems. This research paper investigates using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to predict heart disease risk based on retinal fundus images automatically. We investigated different CNN designs and approaches, including developing proposed models and using pre-trained models such as EfficientNetB0 and B7. Experimental results show that a Heart Disease Prediction (HDP-CNN) model that incorporates a special feature (focal loss) and a preprocessing technique (CLAHE) to improve image clarity achieves superior performance. This method achieved a validation accuracy of 84% with remarkable efficiency. CLAHE preprocessing plays a key role in improving image clarity and enables more accurate feature extraction, which is crucial for accurate risk classification. This research highlights the potential of HDP-CNNs for automatic prediction of heart disease risk and offers a promising avenue for early detection of heart disease and efficient management.

articleTitle: Predicting Fouling Progress in Water Cooled Chillers Using Bidirectional LSTM Neural Networks and Synthetic Data
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The primary challenge in developing a practical predictive model for equipment cleaning is determining the variables the neural network should calculate, focusing on a cost-benefit analysis. Given the impracticality of using real installation data due to the slow development of deposits, synthetic data were generated using a theoretical model in Engineering Equation Solver, considering variations in external wet bulb temperature and chiller parameters. These simulations, improving upon previous studies, trained neural networks to recognize fouling patterns in new data. The final model, suitable for real applications, was created using Python and executed in Google Colab Notebook, leveraging TensorFlow, Keras, NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn libraries. A Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture with the "tanh" activation function and Adam optimization was adopted, balancing accurate modeling and avoiding overfitting. The model was trained with 10,000 data points, using time, wet bulb temperature, condensation temperature, conductance, pump pressure, and tube length as inputs, and Rf as the output. The results highlighted fouling progression and its impact on chiller performance, demonstrating the viability of this approach. Future work includes testing in real installations, adapting the model using transfer learning, and exploring different architectures and additional physical parameters.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Forecasting and Inventory Optimization using Machine Learning Models and Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The growing availability of big data and machine learning has led to a focus on data-driven solutions in Operations and Supply Chain Management (OSCM). This research aims to develop predictive and prescriptive analytics models to address challenges in supply chain forecasting and inventory optimization. The proposed Demand Forecasting Model (DFM) combines big data analytics and machine learning to provide accurate forecasts for operational and tactical decisions. A novel Demand Forecasting Decision Model (DFDM) is developed to provide long-term forecasts where big data models are not applicable. The research also explores the applicability of human judgment in the era of artificial intelligence. A novel supply chain forecasting framework is proposed, combining temporal and cross-sectional hierarchical forecasting to generate coherent forecasts at all levels of a supply chain. A data-driven inventory optimization model is developed, solving the multi-item inventory optimization problem with limited capacity/budget using machine learning and optimization. The proposed models and methodologies have numerous applications across various industries, including fashion, food, energy, electronics, and media. The proposed models and methodologies have numerous applications across supply chains of various industries.

articleTitle: An AI-Based Bot for Student Academic Information using NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In today's educational landscape, traditional methods of delivering academic content often result in delays and inefficiencies due to information repetition. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative AI-based bot leveraging Natural Language Processing (NLP) for personalized academic assistance. This chatbot integrates seamlessly with existing educational information systems, employing NLP techniques to analyze and comprehend student queries efficiently. Enhanced by machine learning algorithms, the bot provides accurate responses swiftly. This synergistic fusion of AI and NLP holds immense potential to elevate the student experience, offering rapid and personalized academic support. The system's adaptability and effectiveness will be continually refined through user feedback from students and faculty members, ensuring its perpetual relevance and impact. Ultimately, our proposed AI-based bot has the transformative potential to redefine the conventional academic information system, enhancing the overall educational environment of the institution.

articleTitle: Role of Machine Learning in Acute Stroke Imaging: A Technical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The utilization of machine learning (ML) and pattern recognition algorithms, which is used for analysis of complex datasets to detect similarities, differences, or trends, which can be particularly useful in medical diagnostics, has become essential in enhancing the prognostics of various neurological diseases such as Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS). These advanced techniques have particularly transformed the evaluation and exploitation of neuroimaging data in the assessment and management of Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS). In addition, these techniques also enable rapid and accurate analysis of complex imaging data, aiding clinicians in timely diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and outcome prediction for stroke patients. This paper focuses on a comprehensive examination of machine learning algorithm strategies to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of predicting strokes. The author has explored and reviewed different ML algorithms and has also delved into stroke prevention to advance our understanding.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis of Cervical Cancer Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Cervical cancer is currently the second most frequent malignancy in women worldwide. The cervix, or entrance to the uterus, is where this cancer begins to grow. Because the nucleus can occasionally be challenging to discern with the unaided eye, hospital physicians frequently struggle to identify cancer cells. The normal cells’s nuceli are small in size in comparison to the aberrant cells. Because abnormal nuclei tend to be larger, it can occasionally be difficult to distinguish them simply using the naked eye to define cervical cancer stages. This is due to the fact that every physician observes the cancer nucleus from a different point of view, thus making it impossible to accurately reduce the accuracy of the classification. In order to diagnose cervical cancer, numerous researchers have recently suggested techniques for the identification and categorization of Pap smear pictures. This method can increase the accuracy of detection and classification, leading to improved outcomes with precise samples and data balance. After retesting, some individuals who were previously classified as being in Stage 2 are actually in Stage 4, when there is very little possibility of recovery. This is due to medical professionals' inability to obtain accurate balancing data and acquire quality samples. A thorough analysis of cervical recognition based on segment core and classification is covered in this article.

articleTitle: Big Data-Driven Strategies for Growth in 3PL with Advanced IT Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The focus of this paper is to examine how different big data initiatives support the development and operations of third party logistics providers. Focusing on the use of advanced technologies like IoT, AI, and ML in the context of 3PL, the research has the objective to show how these innovations enhance efficiency, operating cost, and customer satisfaction. Information gathered from live monitoring, use of algorithms or predictive techniques, and integration of logistics optimization techniques are used to highlight performance enhancement. According to the proposed model, the processes related to the utilisation of big data and IT solutions are divided into several categories: big data acquisition, cloud computing, and subsequent constant evaluation. This study reveals insights that 3PL providers can create a sustainable competitive advantage to the clientele firms by adopting accurate demand forecasting, improvement of routes, and optimization of supply chain visibility. Thus, the findings of this study add to the current literature and practice by enumerating effective big data technologies to apply in logistics management and showcasing how these advancements can catalyze sustainable development.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Tea Leaf Pathogen using Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Crop diseases pose a substantial economic threat to societies, impacting plant functionality, growth, and overall agricultural activities. The widespread consumption of tea and its status as a perennial crop face numerous illnesses that threaten its yield. Early detection is crucial for effective disease management and optimal tea production. For maximum tea production and efficient disease treatment, early detection is essential. Visual inspection is a common component of traditional procedures for detecting tea sickness, although it can be laborious and prone to human mistakes. Since many of the prior systems were not very accurate, deep learning models are employed to create the best model possible for the classification of diseases of tea leaves. The suggested method for the categorization of tea leaf disease consists of three hybrid models: VGG16 with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Inceptionv3 with LSTM, and NASNetMobile with LSTM. After training on an extensive dataset comprising healthy and diseased tea leaf images, the effectiveness of three hybrid models is rigorously evaluated using various performance metrics. Subsequently, the best-performing model is identified for the classification of tea leaf diseases. This paper contributes to the advancement of intelligent tea agricultural methods by showcasing the potential of Deep Learning for early disease detection, paving the way for improved disease management and enhanced tea production.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network,Transfer Learning, Early detection

articleTitle: Enhanced Dual Image Embedding Technique for Robust Image Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Digital image embedding techniques are widely recognized for their utility in preserving copyright, ensuring digital imprint security, and authenticating image integrity. Moreover, factors such as the selection of embedding bits and the methodology employed for digital imprint creation play crucial roles in determining the efficacy of any embedding approach. This study endeavors to introduce a novel dual image based embedding technique leveraging an exclusive-or (XOR) operation to bolter security measures while minimizing the perceptibility of artifacts within the digital imprinted image. A viable approach refining the least significant bit (LSB) replacement strategy and applying it to the pixels of the cover image (CI) for digital imprint bit substitution, thereby limiting pixel modification to a singular instance. This method facilitates the incorporation of two bits of digital imprint information per pixel, thereby offering enhanced capacity for digital imprint insertion, perceptual transparency, and security.

articleTitle: Advanced Intrusion Detection Using Multilayer Perceptron Neural Networks Performance Benchmarking and Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Due to their reliance on signature-based techniques, which lead to high false positive rates and limited flexibility to changing threats, traditional intrusion detection systems (IDS) are inadequate and represent a persistent challenge in cybersecurity. The paper proposes an advanced intrusion detection method that uses Multilayer Perceptron Neural Networks (MLPNNs) to overcome these drawbacks. The technique reduces false positives and improves detection accuracy by combining advanced feature extraction techniques with deep learning algorithms. The proposed system outperforms existing systems in terms of performance metrics due to careful data collecting, preprocessing, model architecture design, and validation. The system's effectiveness in precisely recognizing intrusions while lowering false alarms is demonstrated by the results, which show a detection accuracy of 98.5%, a false positive rate of 2.1%, and an AUC of 0.975. The proposed system also shows reduced durations for training and validation in addition to a more thorough evaluation methodology, confirming its dependability and efficacy in enhancing network security against changing cyber threats.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Road Sign Detection: The Ultimate Road Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This work offers a methodical approach to detecting road signs using CNN, deep learning, and algorithms. As a one-unit regression problem, the object detection problem is defined as follows: probability classes and straight image pixels to bounding box coordinates. Many innovative ideas that are implemented to make our lives simpler and faster than they were in the past have been brought about by the rapid modernization. The Road Sign Detection Technique is one such technique. With this method, all it takes to make a forecast is a quick glance at the picture or sign. This is similar to image classification which uses Convolutional Neural Networks and makes use of AI-powered algorithms. The concept is described as the signs to be detected with the help of some rules that define the color, shape and the region where the signs are spotted. The paper describes YOLO (You Only Look Once) is a concept that is a modern approach to object detection. The object detection issue might be seen as a one-unit regression problem, with the solution representing the straight image pixels to the bounding box coordinates and class probabilities. Utilizing this method, you we can predict something just on a quick glance at the picture or sign.

articleTitle: Advanced IoT and Machine Learning Techniques for Effective Heart Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The worldwide statistics of heart diseases are increasing; therefore, new strategies for the prevention and effective treatment are becoming important. The findings of this study seeks to develop complex solutions involving IoT and ML in increasing the efficiency of diagnosis of heart diseases. The study establishes an IoT based system for health monitoring to collect essential cardiovascular data using wearable sensors. The data is processed using more sophisticated methods of machine learning, and the forecasted results are potential heart diseases. The effectiveness of the proposed system is assessed by using the large dataset yielded by such diagnostic measures as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity enhanced when compared to conventional approaches. The results stress the importance of the synergy between two often-discussed buzzwords, IoT and ML, to transform the diagnosis of heart diseases and hence, help create the future intelligent healthcare systems.

articleTitle: A Transformer-Based Approach for Enhancing Automated Essay Scoring
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Automated essay scoring (AES) is a crucial technology for modern educational systems, providing a consistent and efficient method for evaluating written assignments. Traditional manual grading is often time-consuming, subjective, and prone to inconsistency, which can impact the quality of education and feedback. To address these challenges, we developed an AES system using the RoBERTa model, utilizing its advanced natural language processing capabilities. Our approach involved training and fine-tuning the RobERTa model on the Automated Student Assessment Prize (ASAP) dataset, which consists of diverse student essays graded by human raters. The model was trained to understand and replicate the scoring patterns and criteria used in the ASAP dataset, enabling it to predict accurate scores for new essays. The performance of our AES system was evaluated using the quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) metric, a standard measure for assessing agreement between predicted scores and human grades. Our system achieved a QWK score of 0.815, indicating a high level of accuracy and reliability in essay scoring. By ensuring consistent and objective grading, our AES system can support educators in delivering better learning outcomes. This result demonstrates the potential of the RoBERTa-based AES system to enhance the educational process through timely and fair assessments of student writing.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Classification Using Quantum Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Comprehensive spectrum information is provided by hyperspectral imaging and is necessary for data processing and remote sensing. Yet, efficient categorization is hampered by its great dimensionality and intricate spectral fingerprints. We present a novel method in this paper to tackle these issues by utilizing Quantum Machine Learning (QML), more especially Quantum Neural Networks (QNN). In order to maintain crucial spectral information while lowering data complexity, we use dimensionality reduction techniques like Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Kernel PCA (KPCA). To develop Modified Quantum Neural Network (MQNN) models for multi-class classification, these reduced representations are coupled with conventional Neural Networks (NN). Tested on the Salinas, Pavia, and Indian Pines datasets, our findings show that QML approaches are more accurate when processing high-dimensional hyperspectral data, presenting new opportunities for use in environmental monitoring, agriculture, and urban planning.

articleTitle: Biomimetic and Biological Sensing Technologies for the Assessment of Water Contaminants
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Biological sensors, including biosensors and biomimetic sensors, have gained significant attention in recent years due to their exceptional capabilities in detecting and monitoring pollutants in water environments. These sensors employ biological components such as bacteria, Fungi, enzymes, antibodies, microbial cells, or biomimetic materials to recognize and quantify specific contaminants to pathogens, with high sensitivity and selectivity. This review provides an in-depth analysis of the current state-of-the-art in biological sensor technology for water quality assessment. It discusses the underlying principles of biological sensing mechanisms and explores recent advances in sensor fabrication, including materials, immobilization techniques, and signal transduction methods. Moreover, the review examines the diverse applications of biological sensors in water monitoring, ranging from detecting chemical pollutants to assessing microbial contamination. Additionally, challenges such as stability, reproducibility, and field deployment are addressed, along with future directions for research and development to further enhance the performance and applicability of biological sensors in safeguarding water resources and public health. Here, we employed three models—SVM, logistic regression (LR), and random forest (RF)—to determine the biological and chemical components of water, such as bacteria, fungi, enzymes, antibodies, microbial cells, or biomimetic materials, in order to determine whether it is being utilized for drinking water. Because there are fewer datasets available for biological and chemical components, the dataset was created using machine learning (ML) models. Three machine learning models were used to calculate water pollutants percentages, with SVM proving most effective for irrigation and domestic water, and LR for drinking water, resulting in accurate water supply.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Internet of Things (IoT) Security: Applications, Architecture, Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: In recent years, the Internet of Things (IoT) has rapidly become indispensable in our day-to-day activities. It has emerged as a leading technology around the world. The impact of IoT communication technology on our daily lives in the future is expected to be tremendous. IoT, however, has numerous security and privacy concerns. To gain trust of majority of users using IoT based applications IoT devices should provide data confidentiality, authenticity, integrity and access control. This makes the necessary adjustments to the current architecture imperative. As a result, we thoroughly reviewed the main security concerns with IoT applications and architecture in this paper. Further it covers the countermeasures along with upcoming solutions. Furthermore, it explores the three-tier structure of IoT framework, specifically the Perception, Network, and Application tiers, while showcasing various real-world applications of IoT.

articleTitle: Harnessing ChatGPT in Financial Services: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The introduction of ChatGPT in the banking sector has resulted in a massive revolution of technology engagement. However, the wide use of the technology calls for great ethical concerns. Let this piece be the window through which you peer into these policy issues: framing impartial results, creation of fake information to head financial decisions, invasion of privacy (and its bedfellow security), operations tacitness (and non-transparency due to GPT), job losses and not forgetting the legal jargon tsunami. This document emphasises action and not merely words; it challenges financial institutions to deal with the teething troubles before they are acted upon and consider laws enactment. The importance of an ethical framework gets highlighted—with events that range from continental drift, which might appear to be promising not only academic pastures on AI’s unexplored attachment with money but also bringing into focus blind spots in the real world. One of the most crucial factors of this kind is decreasing the bias by including more variables in the training datasets and measuring more frequently, which minimises the possible negative outcomes.

articleTitle: Data Integrity and Cost Efficiency in Smart Grids: Block-chain Integration Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to minimize power generation costs by harnessing the potential of an adaptive BAT algorithm synergistically integrated with block-chain technology, particularly Proof of Work (PoW). The focus is on optimizing power generation in complex electrical grids, exemplified through experimentation on the IEEE 14 bus system and the IEEE 30 bus system. By leveraging the adaptability of the BAT algorithm and the decentralized ledger capabilities of block-chain technology, the proposed methodology offers a robust solution to the power generation cost minimization conundrum. Through extensive testing and validation, the efficacy of the approach is demonstrated, showcasing significant improvements over existing optimization techniques. Furthermore, the comparative analysis reveals that the proposed approach consistently outperforms conventional methods in terms of efficiency and effectiveness. The results underscore the transformative potential of integrating advanced optimization algorithms with block-chain technology in addressing critical challenges within the energy sector.

articleTitle: Edge AI: A Comprehensive Survey of Technologies, Applications, and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The convergence of edge computing with Artificial Intelligence has accelerated growth of Edge AI, a transformative approach that brings intelligence straight to the point of data generation. Edge AI represents a transformative paradigm in artificial intelligence, facilitating information analysis and real-time decision making at the periphery of the network. This paper provides an overview of Edge AI, including its architectural models, key frameworks, and applications. Architectures such as Client-Server, Federated Learning, Pipeline, Distributed, and Hierarchical are explored, along with frameworks like PyTorch Mobile, ONNX, TensorFlow Lite, and OpenVINO, which facilitate the implementation of Artificial Intelligence models at the edge. Advantages of adopting Edge AI, such as scalability, bandwidth efficiency, resilience, enhanced security, and reduced latency are discussed, highlighting its suitability for various applications across industries. Applications of Edge AI in healthcare, smart homes, industrial IoT, autonomous vehicles, and retail are also examined. Overall, Edge AI represents a pragmatic methodology to unlock the full potential of Artificial Intelligence at the edge, paving way for a more intelligent and connected world.

articleTitle: ChatGPT: A Critical Examination of Its Growth, Ethical Issues, and Future Promise
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The emergence of ChatGPT marks a significant technological breakthrough, offering natural language generation capabilities powered by advanced artificial intelligence techniques. This investigation delves into the inception and functioning of ChatGPT, highlighting its widespread adoption across diverse academic disciplines and industries. ChatGPT's deployment spans content creation, customer service, and natural language processing, showcasing its versatility and adaptability. Through an in-depth examination, this report evaluates the merits and demerits of ChatGPT, elucidating its features and constraints. The benefits of ChatGPT include its ability to generate coherent and contextually relevant responses to user prompts, thereby enhancing efficiency and productivity in various domains. However, its reliance on pre-existing data and potential susceptibility to biases pose notable drawbacks. Moreover, the report delves into the inferences of ChatGPT in sectors, including academia, cyber security, software development, employment, and information technology. ChatGPT's impact on these areas underscores the need for careful consideration of ethical and privacy. In exploring the potential uses of ChatGPT for academicians and researchers, the report highlights its utility in automating certain tasks, facilitating data analysis, and augmenting research productivity. However, it also underscores the importance of maintaining human oversight and critical evaluation when leveraging ChatGPT for scholarly purposes. In conclusion, this investigation provides a comprehensive overview of ChatGPT, offering insights into its operation, impact, and prospects across a myriad of domains.

articleTitle: Automatic Face Recognition-Based Attendance System using 2D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Monitoring attendance is a crucial component in identifying a person’s presence in a corporate or educational setting. The modern method of recording attendance without the possibility of proxies can be accomplished simply by recognizing a person’s face. Hence, face recognition of an individual can make the laborious work of manually recording attendance easier. Convolutional neural network is a deep learning-based ok method, which is used to run the integrated attendance system. The real-time capture of the image allows for the recognition of a person’s face. After the dataset has been collected, the features are retrieved as NumPy arrays. The model’s primary goal is to identify various faces and log the desired attendance. A file with the extension of ‘*.txt’ contains a record of every person’s attendance. Since it makes it simpler to categorize the attendance daily, the file name is preserved as the date on which the attendance was recorded. At one moment, it is possible to recognize the faces of several people and store the names in a specific text file. In the work, authors discussed the above strategies to implement the model.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Drones and Big Data for Supply Chain Optimization Using a Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This research paper aims to provide qualitative and quantitative insights regarding the application of drones and big data techniques in the SCM field through a new scientific method. The proposed method exploits the opportunities of drones for real-time data capturing and big data technologies to enrich decision making in supply chain. The study is pertinent to modern tendencies in supply chain systems and proves the efficiency of the new method through the precise calculations and contrastive analysis. The following are some of the findings that suggest efficiency, cost decrease, and outstanding performance of the supply chain. The studies being offered in this research will prove beneficial for practitioners and researchers who endeavor to advance the concepts and practice of logistics and supply chain management.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration for Future Selection-LSTM Stock Prediction Algorithm based on the Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Forecasting stock prices is essential because of its substantial ramifications for people, organizations, and governments. This research investigates the convergence of sophisticated data mining methods, 5G technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT) to improve the accuracy of predicting stock prices. To overcome the difficulties associated with decreased accuracy and intricate training procedures in stock prediction models, to suggest using a hybrid methodology that integrates Feature Selection (FS) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. This approach seeks to forecast the final price of stocks by using an enhanced collection of characteristics derived from 15 commonly used indicators in the stock market. By using feature selection (FS), we decrease the number of data dimensions and enhance the efficiency of model training. Subsequently, the LSTM model is used to predict stock values. The findings of the research indicate that the FS-LSTM hybrid model substantially enhances the accuracy of predictions, resulting in a notable decrease of 15% in mean squared error compared to conventional LSTM networks. These results highlight the possibility of combining IoT and 5G technology in financial forecasting, which may lead to more dependable and efficient predictions of stock prices.

articleTitle: Illness and Gender Classification of Cattle
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Cattles are one of the most important components of the global agriculture industry as they provide essential resources like meat and dairy products. This is the reason cattle health is very crucial to ensure animal welfare. This paper presents a deep learning model designed to classify cattles based on gender and diagnose illness in an efficient manner. In this paper two different datasets have been used, one for gender classification and the other for illness detection. Through an extensive dataset of cattle images, the model designed using deep learning techniques learns to distinguish between male and female cattle with a high degree of accuracy. Additionally, the model designed here has the capability of detecting signs of illness or distress in cattles based on visual cures, such as changes in posture, skin condition and facial expressions. The model can be proved helpful in timely intervention, therefore improving overall animal welfare economic. Moreover, this research opens doors for the development of similar models in the broader context of livestock management and animal health.

articleTitle: Challenges and Constraints of 5G: Transformation and Prospects for 6G Era
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Fifth generation technology(5G) is available in several countries with more than 1.5 million users. It’s wireless communication through which many applications are integrated. With the rapid growth of more and more of the 5G network, many limitations have been found. Certain limitations regarding security and privacy were familiarized due to which 6G networks of next generation provide the solutions to overcome 5G. Whenever communications take place, human possibilities will depend on a set of security technology enablers. The recent 6G effort is presented in relation to privacy as well as security limitations of 5G. Knowledge extraction was not reliable in 5G, so will work on AI/ML implementation through federated learning. The 6G cyber security threats will be defined. 6G architecture breaks up how it will work when it will have multiple stakeholders. This paper also defines how the various domains of privacy, trust, cyber-resilience are decomposed. In short, here we will explore various 6G security Technologies which are revolutionizing..

articleTitle: Exploring the Tangible Impact of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Bridging the Gap between Hype and Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Beyond being merely trendy terms in technology, machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) have directly influenced every industry. This article thus demystifies the true meaning of these technologies by sifting through the sultry descriptions. Here, we explore how AI and ML enhance efficiency, decision-making, and problem-solving in various sectors including health, Agriculture, finance, and production as we discover real-world applications. Continuing with the discussion of implementation challenges, the aspects of bias, ethical pitfalls, and report cards are examined. In addition, the article also covered how the integration of AI as well as ML remains a way of improving processes, creating better user experiences, and spurring innovation. This paper, which is also based on case studies, discusses the relationship between social welfare and AI and the importance of AI’s development and use being done responsibly. Considering all the discussed aspects, this volume provides a rather nuanced perspective on AI and ML, unmasking the myths around these concepts to reveal the fact that they have a highly significant impact on the current reality and its projected evolutions.

articleTitle: Biometric Identification using Gait Analysis: Methods, Characteristics, and Difficulties
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Gait recognition is a rapidly developing field of study that applies biometrics to identify people by their distinctive walking patterns. Gait recognition primarily performs identification authentication by utilizing the unique postures of each individual. These methods aim to recognize people according to their intrinsic, visible qualities, regardless of their clothing or personal effects. While the topic suggests a long-standing challenge, the majority of solutions developed to tackle it suffer from a number of drawbacks, such as poor feature extraction and low classification rates. Deep learning-based methods, on the other hand, have lately become a powerful toolkit to tackle almost every picture and computer vision-related issue, and they also yield excellent gait identification results. With an emphasis on deep learning methodologies, we hope to highlight their advantages and expose their drawbacks to help researchers make well-informed selections about the many variables to be considered for learning gait identification. Additionally, various case studies on implication of gait recognition using different deep learning models are discussed to provide an overview of the practical applications of this technique.

articleTitle: Wearable Web Enabled IoT-Based Health Monitoring Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The healthcare industry is one of the domains where the Internet of Things (IoT) has made the global impact. By intelligently integrating applications into medical devices, IoT enables the provision of smart and efficient healthcare facilities. Through such sensors, which can be either surgically placed or worn on the body, patients can be monitored continually using the advanced technologies. Such data collection allows for the analysis, mining, and aggregation of information to facilitate early disease prediction. Sophisticated remote health monitoring systems have been developed due to the availability of cheap smart phones and wearable sensors. Even if doctors/pharmacists are unavailable, such health monitoring IoT solutions can be helpful in disease prevention/management and accurate patient diagnosis. In this paper, a novel IoT-based wireless remote health monitoring system for a patient in an indoor environment is presented for monitoring continuous patient vital sign data like temperature and pulse. The collected data is stored on an IoT platform so that only the authorised person can obtain the data. This makes it possible for the doctors to diagnose conditions from the information that has been collected, and this improves the chances of offering effective care at the right time.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Various Workflow Scheduling Techniques in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: Cloud computing (CC) is a modern technology which deploys networks of servers, positioned in extensive remote areas, for conducting operations on a larger quantity of data. In CC, a workflow module is employed for representing diverse scientific and web applications. One of the major problems is scheduling larger workflows of tasks on the heterogeneous CC environment. This article summarizes some important research works in the field of CC associated with workflow scheduling (WS). At first, this survey represents the common structure of WS in cloud and then, scheduling approaches are catalogued into four techniques like Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), Hybrid and Algorithmic-based approaches are discussed in detail. Thereafter, the research gaps faced by the traditional approaches for WS will help the researchers in future for building an innovative model. This study considers 25 research articles focused on different methodologies employed for WS in cloud. Lastly, the evaluation is performed in the survey regarding year of publication, performance measures, research technique, and attainment of the research models. It is acknowledged that algorithmic based modules are usually employed approaches, while cloudsim is repeatedly applied tool for WS in CC. Moreover, makespan is the utilized analytic measure with superior value.

articleTitle: Analysis of CNN Models for Eye Disease Classification Using Retinal Images
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: The main goal of our study is to create an automated system that combines retinal pictures and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to classify eye illnesses. We investigate distinct CNN designs, such as VGG19, ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, and DenseNet121, by utilizing the TensorFlow and Keras packages. Transfer learning allows us to fine-tune pretrained models into four categories of retinal pictures classification: normal condition, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and cataract. With a dataset of labeled retinal pictures, the models are assessed and trained, and notable accuracy is attained. With a remarkable accuracy of 90.95%, EfficientNetB0 emerges as the best-performing model. The objective of our initiative is to lessen the strain on healthcare systems caused by manual screening and diagnosis while also facilitating early detection and diagnosis of eye illnesses.

articleTitle: Prediction of Benign and Malignant Breast Cancer using Machine Learning Techniques: A Review and Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
abstract: This Breast cancer (BC) is a predominant illness majorly found in women which may cause death if predicted in an uncontrolled stage. In BC, breast cell rises uncontrolled and infects the surrounding part of the breast. To detect BC in premature stages using simple, rapid, and correctly detected methods, machine learning (ML) techniques played a vital role. This paper mainly emphasizes different ML algorithms such as Classification and Regression Tree (CART), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Naive Bayesian (NB) to detect benign and malignant BC then a comparative analysis of these algorithms has been performed and tested on the standard BC datasets. These datasets were pre-processed first to minimize error after that ML models were trained and tested. The investigated experimental results of ML algorithms are evaluated on accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score metrics. The SVM technique shows 98.83% accuracy and significantly improved performances on other metrics. These discoveries could help to the early prediction of BC and save life.

articleTitle: A Credit Risk Assessment System for Financial Institutions Utilizing Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 1st International Conference on Advanced Computing and Emerging Technologies (ACET)
